#LI-Hybrid 3 jours/semaine au bureau

Titre de l'emploi interne : Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Data42

À propos du rôle :
Le Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) de Data42 est un chef de file technique intégré qui collabore directement avec les équipes de domaine pour transformer des problèmes de grande valeur en données de travail et applications d'IA. Vous allez rapidement prototyper, itérer et produire des solutions sur la fonderie de Palantir, les utilisateurs de passerelle, les produits et l'ingénierie de plate-forme pour fournir des résultats mesurables. Ce rôle combine l'ingénierie logicielle, l'ingénierie des données et la résolution de problèmes axés sur les produits, l'accent étant mis sur l'adoption du flux de travail des utilisateurs et la durabilité opérationnelle.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités :

• Livraison intégrée et résolution de problèmes : Intégré avec des équipes de domaine pour comprendre les flux de travail, définir les critères de succès et traduire les besoins en capacités expédiées; Découverte de plomb, cadrage de solution et livraison itérative du prototype à la production.

• Build on Palantir Foundry : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions de bout en bout dans Foundry , y compris les pipelines de données, les transformations, l'alignement de l'ontologie et les workflows d'application ; Configurer et optimiser les applications basées sur Foundry pour soutenir la prise de décision opérationnelle et l'analyse répétable; Appliquer les modèles Foundry-native pour les permissions, l'auditabilité, la performance et la gestion des rejets.

• Ingérer, transformer et modéliser divers ensembles de données pour les rendre utilisables et fiables pour l'analyse et les applications; Définir les contrôles de la qualité des données et s'assurer que les ensembles de données sont adaptés à l'usage prévu (hypothèses et limites relatives aux documents).

• Développement et intégration d'applications : Développer des applications orientées vers l'utilisateur ou des expériences de flux de travail et s'intégrer avec les systèmes en amont et en aval au besoin; Soutenir le déploiement, le suivi et l'amélioration continue des applications de production.

• Leadership interfonctionnel : S'associer étroitement avec les gestionnaires de produits, les data savants, les ingénieurs de données, la gouvernance et les équipes de plateforme pour aligner la portée, les délais et les normes; Communiquer clairement les compromis et débloquer l'exécution grâce à l'influence technique et des intervenants.

• Activer et réutiliser : Créer des modèles, des composants et des modèles réutilisables pour accélérer les futures livraisons dans Data42; Les coéquipiers mentors et contribuer à la documentation interne, aux livres de lecture et aux normes de livraison.

Exigences essentielles:

• Baccalauréat en biologie, bioingénierie, bioinformatique, biostatistique ou discipline connexe.

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience en recherche biomédicale, en bioingénierie, en bioinformatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

• L'expérience pratique avec Palantir Foundry est essentielle, la construction et l'opérationnalisation de solutions (pipélines, ontologie, applications et contrôles d'accès), avec un état d'esprit d'ingénierie première Foundry et de livraison.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation Support: This role is based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

Join Novartis and play a vital role in protecting the innovations that transform patients’ lives. As a Senior Patent Paralegal, you will be a trusted expert partner within our Intellectual Property team, managing complex global patent portfolios and helping bring groundbreaking scientific discoveries to market. This is an opportunity to work closely with patent professionals, inventors, and international partners while driving operational excellence, shaping best practices, and contributing to a highly collaborative global environment where your expertise can make a tangible impact.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Manage complex global patent portfolios and ensure timely execution of intellectual property filing activities.

• Prepare and coordinate European, United States, international, and foreign patent application documentation.

• Monitor patent dockets, deadlines, and correspondence to safeguard intellectual property rights.

• Serve as a key resource on patent procedures, regulations, and best practices.

• Collaborate with patent attorneys, inventors, and international partners to advance innovation programs.

• Lead process improvement initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and service quality.

• Mentor and train colleagues on patent prosecution processes and intellectual property administration.

• Support cross-functional projects and contribute to continuous improvement across global operations.

Essential Requirements

• Paralegal or intellectual property certification, or equivalent professional experience in patent administration.

• Extensive experience managing international patent prosecution activities in a law firm or corporate environment.

• Strong knowledge of European, United States, Patent Cooperation Treaty, and foreign filing practices.

• Proven ability to manage complex patent portfolios with exceptional accuracy and attention to detail.

• Excellent written and spoken English communication skills and ability to collaborate globally.

• Proven sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in collaborative teams.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 82.600 - CHF 153.400

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Adaptability, Business Acumen, Contract Law, Critical Thinking, Curious Mindset, Decision Making, Legal Document Preparation, Legal Practices, Legal Support Services, Legal Writing, Negotiation, Persuasion, Proactive Planning, Problem Solving, Relationship Building, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #

Partecipa a Novartis e gioca un ruolo vitale nella protezione delle innovazioni che trasformano la vita dei pazienti. Come Senior Patent Paralegal, sarai un partner esperto di fiducia all'interno del nostro team di Proprietà Intellettuale, gestendo complessi portafogli di brevetti globali e aiutando a portare al mercato scoperte scientifiche innovative. Si tratta di un'opportunità per lavorare a stretto contatto con professionisti del brevetto, inventori e partner internazionali mentre guidano l'eccellenza operativa, modellando le migliori pratiche, e contribuendo a un ambiente globale altamente collaborativo in cui la vostra competenza può dare un impatto tangibile.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Gestire complessi portafogli di brevetti globali e garantire l'esecuzione tempestiva delle attività di deposito di proprietà intellettuale.

• Preparare e coordinare documenti di domanda di brevetto europei, Stati Uniti, internazionali e stranieri.

• Monitorare i bacini, le scadenze e la corrispondenza per tutelare i diritti di proprietà intellettuale.

• Servire come risorsa chiave per procedure di brevetto, regolamenti e best practice.

• Collabora con avvocati brevetti, inventori e partner internazionali per promuovere i programmi di innovazione.

• Iniziative di miglioramento del processo di piombo che migliorano l'efficienza operativa e la qualità del servizio.

• Mentore e formare colleghi sui processi di prosecuzione dei brevetti e l'amministrazione della proprietà intellettuale.

• Sostenere i progetti interfunzionali e contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle operazioni globali.

Requisiti essenziali

• Certificazione di proprietà paralegale o intellettuale, o esperienza professionale equivalente nella gestione dei brevetti.

• Ampia esperienza di gestione delle attività di procura internazionale dei brevetti in uno studio legale o in un ambiente aziendale.

• Forte conoscenza del trattato di cooperazione europea, degli Stati Uniti, dei brevetti e delle pratiche di deposito straniere.

• Prova capacità di gestire portafogli di brevetti complessi con eccezionale precisione e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e parlata inglese e capacità di collaborare a livello globale.

• Senso di proprietà e responsabilità, con una mentalità proattiva, orientata alla soluzione e la capacità di prosperare in team collaborativi.

Vantaggi e premi
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: CHF 82.600 - CHF 153.400

Lo stipendio base offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, come competenze rilevanti, competenze ed esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf

Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo sulla base della vostra posizione di lavoro e dell'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente all'utente durante il processo di applicazione.

Impegno alla diversità e all'inclusione:
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale e inclusivo e diverse squadre rappresentative dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Accessibilità e alloggio:
Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, avete bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di una posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a Diversi.inclusion ch@novartis.com e fateci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Competenze desiderate
Adaptability, Business Acumen, Diritto Contratto, Critical Thinking, Curious Mindset, Decision Making, Legal Document Preparation, Legal Practices, Legal Support Services, Legal Writing, Negotiation, Persuasion, Proactive Planning, Problem Solving, Relationship Building, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Thinking

#LI-Hybrid

Schließen Sie sich Novartis an und spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle beim Schutz der Innovationen, die das Leben der Patienten verändern. Als Senior Patent Paralegal sind Sie ein vertrauenswürdiger Expertenpartner in unserem Team für geistiges Eigentum, das komplexe globale Patentportfolios verwaltet und dazu beiträgt, bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen auf den Markt zu bringen. Dies ist eine Gelegenheit, eng mit Patentexperten, Erfindern und internationalen Partnern zusammenzuarbeiten und gleichzeitig die operative Exzellenz voranzutreiben, Best Practices zu gestalten und zu einem stark kooperativen globalen Umfeld beizutragen, in dem Ihre Expertise spürbare Auswirkungen haben kann.

Stellenbeschreibung
Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Verwalten Sie komplexe globale Patentportfolios und gewährleisten Sie die zeitnahe Durchführung von Einreichungsaktivitäten für geistiges Eigentum.

• Vorbereitung und Koordinierung europäischer, US-amerikanischer, internationaler und ausländischer Patentanmeldungsunterlagen.

• Überwachen Sie Patent-Dockets, Fristen und Korrespondenz, um die Rechte des geistigen Eigentums zu schützen.

• Dienen Sie als eine wichtige Ressource für Patentverfahren, Vorschriften und bewährte Verfahren.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Patentanwälten, Erfindern und internationalen Partnern zusammen, um Innovationsprogramme voranzutreiben.

• Leiten Sie Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen, die die betriebliche Effizienz und Servicequalität verbessern.

• Mentor und schulen Kollegen zu Patentverfolgungsprozessen und Verwaltung von geistigem Eigentum.

• Unterstützen Sie funktionsübergreifende Projekte und tragen Sie zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen in allen globalen Aktivitäten bei.

Grundlegende Anforderungen

• Paralegal oder geistiges Eigentum Zertifizierung oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung in der Patentverwaltung.

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Verwaltung internationaler Patentverfolgungsaktivitäten in einer Anwaltskanzlei oder einem Unternehmensumfeld.

• Starke Kenntnisse der europäischen, Vereinigten Staaten, Patent Cooperation Treaty und ausländische Einreichung Praktiken.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Patentportfolios mit außergewöhnlicher Genauigkeit und Detailgenauigkeit zu verwalten.

• Hervorragende schriftliche und gesprochene englische Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, weltweit zusammenzuarbeiten.

• Bewährtes Gefühl von Eigenverantwortung und Verantwortlichkeit, mit einer proaktiven, lösungsorientierten Denkweise und der Fähigkeit, in kollaborativen Teams zu gedeihen.

Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsbezogenen Bonus, der von bestimmten Leistungsparametern abhängt.

Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub.

Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid

Location: Basel, Switzerland

Relocation is not available for this position. Please only apply if this location is accessible.

Innovation in patient recruitment has never been more critical to bringing medicines to patients faster. As Innovation Capability Director - Global Clinical Operations, you will lead the identification, implementation and scaling of innovative recruitment and patient engagement solutions that improve clinical trial participation around the world. Working across global study teams, technology partners and cross-functional stakeholders, you will transform promising ideas into scalable capabilities that deliver measurable impact for patients, sites and clinical programs.

This is a highly visible leadership role for an innovation expert with proven digital patient recruitment experience, a passion for advancing clinical research and the ability to shape strategy while driving execution in a complex global environment. You will bring deep expertise in digital marketing for patient recruitment, including emerging and artificial intelligence-enabled approaches that improve how patients are identified, engaged and connected with clinical trials.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Lead the adoption and scaling of innovative solutions that improve clinical trial recruitment, participation and patient experience.

• Partner with global study teams, technology providers and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful patient recruitment innovations.

• Drive implementation, governance, risk management and continuous improvement of innovation initiatives across global clinical programs.

• Evaluate digital, data-driven and artificial intelligence-enabled approaches to improve patient identification, engagement and recruitment outcomes.

• Develop scalable frameworks, processes and best practices that support sustainable adoption of successful recruitment innovations.

• Identify emerging technologies, industry trends and recruitment approaches that strengthen organizational capability and innovation leadership.

• Serve as a trusted expert, influencing strategy, building capability and representing Novartis across the clinical research ecosystem.

Essential Requirements

• Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant education and experience.

• At least five years’ clinical trial innovation or solution delivery experience, particularly within clinical trial recruitment.

• At least seven years’ experience within pharmaceutical clinical drug development and a strong understanding of clinical trial operations.

• Proven digital patient recruitment expertise, including developing and implementing digital marketing strategies to identify and engage potential trial participants.

• Experience applying digital tools and artificial intelligence-enabled methods to patient recruitment, selection or matching in clinical trials.

• Strong knowledge of clinical development processes, regulatory requirements and Good Clinical Practice.

• Demonstrated success translating strategy into cross-functional programs and projects within a complex global matrix environment.

• Strong project management, influencing and problem-solving capabilities, with the autonomy and agility to navigate ambiguity and challenge established approaches.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a
position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and a minimum of 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 142,100.00 - 263,900.00 CHF Annual

The salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion / EEO:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams’ representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Benefits and Rewards: Read our handbook to learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally: https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards

Descrizione del lavoro
#LI-Hybrid #

Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera

Il trasferimento non è disponibile per questa posizione. Si prega di applicare solo se questa posizione è accessibile.

L'innovazione nel reclutamento dei pazienti non è mai stata più critica per portare i farmaci ai pazienti più velocemente. In qualità di responsabile della capacità dell'innovazione - Global Clinical Operations, guiderai l'identificazione, l'implementazione e lo scaling di soluzioni di reclutamento innovative e di coinvolgimento dei pazienti che migliorano la partecipazione allo studio clinico in tutto il mondo. Lavorando in team di studio globali, partner tecnologici e stakeholder interfunzionali, trasformerai idee promettenti in capacità scalabili che offrono un impatto misurabile per pazienti, siti e programmi clinici.

Si tratta di un ruolo di leadership altamente visibile per un esperto di innovazione con comprovata esperienza di reclutamento dei pazienti digitali, una passione per il progresso della ricerca clinica e la capacità di modellare la strategia mentre guida l'esecuzione in un ambiente globale complesso. Porterai una profonda esperienza nel marketing digitale per il reclutamento dei pazienti, compresi gli approcci emergenti e artificialmente abilitati all'intelligenza che migliorano il modo in cui i pazienti sono identificati, impegnati e connessi con gli studi clinici.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Guidare l'adozione e lo scaling di soluzioni innovative che migliorano il reclutamento di studi clinici, la partecipazione e l'esperienza del paziente.

• Partner con team di studio globali, fornitori di tecnologia e stakeholder interfunzionali per fornire innovazioni di reclutamento dei pazienti impattanti.

• Guidare l'implementazione, la governance, la gestione dei rischi e il miglioramento continuo delle iniziative di innovazione nei programmi clinici globali.

• Valuta gli approcci digitali, basati sui dati e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale per migliorare i risultati di identificazione, coinvolgimento e reclutamento dei pazienti.

• Sviluppare framework, processi e best practice scalabili che supportano l'adozione sostenibile delle innovazioni di reclutamento di successo.

• Identificare tecnologie emergenti, tendenze del settore e approcci di reclutamento che rafforzano la capacità organizzativa e la leadership dell'innovazione.

• Servire come esperto di fiducia, influenzare la strategia, la capacità di costruzione e rappresentare Novartis attraverso l'ecosistema di ricerca clinica.

Requisiti essenziali

• Laurea Avanzata in Scienze della vita, Assistenza sanitaria o una disciplina correlata, o equivalente istruzione e esperienza rilevanti.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza di sperimentazione clinica o di consegna delle soluzioni, in particolare all’interno del reclutamento di studi clinici.

• Almeno sette anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici farmaceutici e una forte comprensione delle operazioni di sperimentazione clinica.

• Prove competenze di reclutamento dei pazienti digitali, tra cui lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie di marketing digitale per identificare e coinvolgere potenziali partecipanti di prova.

• Esperienza nell'applicazione di strumenti digitali e metodi di intelligenza artificiale abilitati al paziente reclutamento, selezione o corrispondenza in studi clinici.

• Forte conoscenza dei processi di sviluppo clinico, requisiti normativi e buona pratica clinica.

• Dimostrato successo traducendo la strategia in programmi e progetti multifunzionali all'interno di un complesso ambiente di matrice globale.

• Forte gestione del progetto, influenzando e risolvendo i problemi, con l'autonomia e l'agilità di navigare ambiguità e sfida approcci consolidati.

Accessibilità e alloggio
Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, è necessario un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di un
posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a Diversi.inclusion ch@novartis.com e farci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Ricompense
A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, ove possibile, e un minimo di 14 settimane di congedo parentale pagato.

Campo d'insalatura annuale previsto per il ruolo: 142,100.00 - 263,900.00 CHF Annuale

Il salario offerto è determinato sulla base di obiettivi di genere-neutral, quali competenze rilevanti, competenze ed esperienza in conformità con la politica di impostazione della retribuzione Novartis e dopo l'adesione Novartis saranno esaminati periodicamente.

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, potresti essere idoneo per un bonus basato sulle prestazioni a seconda di determinati parametri di prestazione. Ulteriori dettagli saranno forniti durante il processo di applicazione.

Pay equity è un principio fondamentale della nostra politica di occupazione e riflette il nostro impegno a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo che tratta tutti i dipendenti con dignità e rispetto, come descritto nel nostro Codice Etico.

Leggi la nostra brochure per saperne di più sulla nostra offerta globale di premi totali: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
Nota: i benefici e i risarcimenti possono variare per paese e sono soggetti a requisiti legali locali, comprese le disposizioni di contratti collettivi, ove applicabile. Una panoramica completa del pacchetto di compensazione, compresi i dettagli relativi del contratto collettivo applicabile al vostro ruolo sulla base della vostra posizione di lavoro e dell'entità del datore di lavoro Novartis, sarà comunicata separatamente all'utente durante il processo di applicazione.

Impegno alla diversità e all'inclusione / EEO:
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale, inclusivo e rappresentativo di diverse squadre dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Perché Novartis: aiutare le persone con malattie e le loro famiglie prende più di scienza innovativa. Ci vuole una comunità di persone intelligenti e passionali come te. Collaborare, supportare e ispirarsi. Combinando per raggiungere scoperte che cambiano la vita dei pazienti. Pronti a creare un futuro più luminoso insieme? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Vantaggi e premi: Leggi il nostro manuale per conoscere tutti i modi in cui ti aiuteremo a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente: https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits-rewards

Competenze desiderate
Gestione del bilancio, Sviluppo Clinico, Ricerca Clinica, Attuazione della prova clinica, Processo clinico, Trial clinico, Marketing digitale, Strategia digitale, Innovazione, Soluzioni innovative, Reclutamento paziente, Industria farmaceutica

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
#LI-Hybrid

Standort: Basel, Schweiz

Relocation ist für diese Position nicht verfügbar. Bitte nur beantragen, wenn dieser Standort zugänglich ist.

Innovation in der Patientenrekrutierung war noch nie so wichtig, um Medikamente schneller zu Patienten zu bringen. Als Innovation Capability Director - Global Clinical Operations leiten Sie die Identifizierung, Implementierung und Skalierung innovativer Rekrutierungs- und Patientenbindungslösungen, die die Teilnahme an klinischen Studien auf der ganzen Welt verbessern. In Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Studienteams, Technologiepartnern und funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern verwandeln Sie vielversprechende Ideen in skalierbare Fähigkeiten, die messbare Auswirkungen für Patienten, Standorte und klinische Programme haben.

Dies ist eine sehr sichtbare Führungsrolle für einen Innovationsexperten mit bewährter digitaler Patientenrekrutierungserfahrung, einer Leidenschaft für die Förderung der klinischen Forschung und der Fähigkeit, die Strategie zu gestalten und gleichzeitig die Umsetzung in einem komplexen globalen Umfeld voranzutreiben. Sie werden umfassende Expertise im digitalen Marketing für die Patientenrekrutierung mitbringen, einschließlich aufkommender und künstlicher Intelligenz basierender Ansätze, die die Identifizierung, Einbeziehung und Verbindung von Patienten mit klinischen Studien verbessern.

Stellenbeschreibung
Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie die Einführung und Skalierung innovativer Lösungen, die die Rekrutierung klinischer Studien, die Teilnahme und die Patientenerfahrung verbessern.

• Partnerschaft mit globalen Studienteams, Technologieanbietern und funktionsübergreifenden Interessengruppen, um wirkungsvolle Innovationen für die Patientenrekrutierung zu liefern.

• Förderung von Umsetzung, Governance, Risikomanagement und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung von Innovationsinitiativen in globalen klinischen Programmen.

• Bewerten Sie digitale, datengesteuerte und künstliche Intelligenz-fähige Ansätze zur Verbesserung der Identifizierung, des Engagements und der Rekrutierungsergebnisse von Patienten.

• Entwicklung skalierbarer Frameworks, Prozesse und Best Practices, die die nachhaltige Umsetzung erfolgreicher Rekrutierungsinnovationen unterstützen.

• Identifizieren Sie neue Technologien, Branchentrends und Rekrutierungsansätze, die die Organisationsfähigkeit und Innovationsführerschaft stärken.

• Dienen Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Experte, beeinflussen Sie die Strategie, bauen Sie Fähigkeiten auf und vertreten Sie Novartis im gesamten Ökosystem der klinischen Forschung.

Grundlegende Anforderungen

• Fortgeschrittener Abschluss in Life Sciences, Gesundheitswesen oder einer verwandten Disziplin oder gleichwertiger relevanter Ausbildung und Erfahrung.

• Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung in der Innovation klinischer Studien oder in der Bereitstellung von Lösungen, insbesondere im Rahmen der Rekrutierung klinischer Studien.

• Mindestens sieben Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung pharmazeutischer klinischer Arzneimittel und ein fundiertes Verständnis der klinischen Studiengänge.

• Bewährte digitale Patientenrekrutierungskompetenz, einschließlich der Entwicklung und Umsetzung digitaler Marketingstrategien zur Identifizierung und Einbeziehung potenzieller Studienteilnehmer.

• Erfahrung mit der Anwendung digitaler Tools und Methoden mit künstlicher Intelligenz bei der Rekrutierung, Auswahl oder Abstimmung von Patienten in klinischen Studien.

• Ein fundiertes Wissen über klinische Entwicklungsprozesse, regulatorische Anforderungen und gute klinische Praxis.

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Umsetzung von Strategie in funktionsübergreifende Programme und Projekte innerhalb einer komplexen globalen Matrixumgebung.

• Starkes Projektmanagement, Einfluss- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit der Autonomie und Agilität, um Mehrdeutigkeiten zu steuern und etablierte Ansätze herauszufordern.

Zugänglichkeit und Unterbringung
Novartis verpflichtet sich, mit allen Menschen zusammenzuarbeiten und ihnen eine angemessene Unterkunft zu bieten. Wenn Sie aufgrund eines Gesundheitszustands oder einer Behinderung eine angemessene Unterkunft für einen Teil des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen oder um detailliertere Informationen über die wesentlichen Funktionen einer Person zu erhalten.
Bitte senden Sie eine E-Mail an diversity.inclusion ch@novartis.com und teilen Sie uns die Art Ihrer Anfrage und Ihre Kontaktinformationen mit. Bitte geben Sie die Stellenanforderungsnummer in Ihrer Nachricht an.

Prämien
Bei Novartis setzen wir uns dafür ein, die Medizin gemeinsam neu zu gestalten - und die Menschen zu belohnen, die sie ermöglichen.

Die Belohnungen, Teil unseres Teams zu sein, gehen weit über Grundlohn und Anreize hinaus. Wir bieten auch eine Vielzahl von Wettbewerbsvorteilen an, die Ihnen helfen, persönlich und professionell zu gedeihen, wie Versicherungspläne, Altersvorsorgepläne, Wohlbefindensressourcen und globale Anerkennungsprogramme. Darüber hinaus bieten wir flexible und hybride Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, wo möglich, und mindestens 14 Wochen bezahlten Elternurlaub.

Erwartete Jahresgrundgehaltsspanne für die Rolle: 142.100.00 - 263.900.00 CHF Jährlich

Das angebotene Gehalt wird auf der Grundlage von geschlechtsneutralen Zielen wie relevanten Fähigkeiten, Kompetenzen und Erfahrungen gemäß der Lohnpolitik von Novartis festgelegt und wird nach dem Beitritt von Novartis regelmäßig überprüft.

Zusätzlich zu Ihrem Grundgehalt haben Sie möglicherweise Anspruch auf einen leistungsbezogenen Bonus, der von bestimmten Leistungsparametern abhängt. Weitere Details werden während des Bewerbungsprozesses angegeben.

Lohngerechtigkeit ist ein Grundprinzip unserer Beschäftigungspolitik und spiegelt unsere Verpflichtung wider, ein vielfältiges, gerechtes und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, das alle Mitarbeiter mit Würde und Respekt behandelt, wie in unserem Ethikkodex dargelegt.

Lesen Sie unsere Broschüre, um mehr über unser globales Gesamtprämienangebot zu erfahren: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
Hinweis: Leistungen und Entschädigungen können von Land zu Land variieren und unterliegen lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen, einschließlich der Bestimmungen von Tarifverträgen, sofern anwendbar. Eine vollständige Übersicht über Ihr Vergütungspaket, einschließlich aller relevanten Tarifvertragsdetails, die für Ihre Rolle auf der Grundlage Ihres Beschäftigungsorts und Ihrer Arbeitgebereinheit von Novartis gelten, wird Ihnen während des Bewerbungsprozesses separat mitgeteilt.

Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion / EEO:

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
#LI-Hybrid

Lieu: Bâle, Suisse

La réinstallation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste. Veuillez ne faire une demande que si cet emplacement est accessible.

L'innovation dans le recrutement des patients n'a jamais été aussi cruciale pour accélérer l'apport de médicaments aux patients. En tant que directeur des capacités d'innovation - Opérations cliniques mondiales, vous dirigerez l'identification, la mise en oeuvre et l'échelle de solutions novatrices de recrutement et d'engagement des patients qui améliorent la participation des essais cliniques partout dans le monde. En travaillant au sein d'équipes d'étude mondiales, de partenaires technologiques et d'intervenants interfonctionnels, vous transformerez des idées prometteuses en capacités évolutives offrant un impact mesurable pour les patients, les sites et les programmes cliniques.

Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership très visible pour un expert en innovation qui possède une expérience de recrutement numérique éprouvée, une passion pour faire progresser la recherche clinique et la capacité de façonner la stratégie tout en conduisant l'exécution dans un environnement mondial complexe. Vous apporterez une expertise approfondie en marketing numérique pour le recrutement des patients, y compris des approches émergentes et artificielles qui améliorent la façon dont les patients sont identifiés, engagés et liés aux essais cliniques.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger l'adoption et la mise à l'échelle de solutions novatrices qui améliorent le recrutement, la participation et l'expérience des patients dans les essais cliniques.

• Partenaire avec des équipes d'études mondiales, des fournisseurs de technologie et des intervenants interfonctionnels pour offrir des innovations de recrutement de patients impactées.

• Favoriser la mise en oeuvre, la gouvernance, la gestion des risques et l'amélioration continue des initiatives d'innovation dans les programmes cliniques mondiaux.

• Évaluer les approches numériques, axées sur les données et fondées sur l'intelligence artificielle afin d'améliorer l'identification des patients, l'engagement et le recrutement.

• Élaborer des cadres, des processus et des pratiques exemplaires évolutives qui favorisent l'adoption durable d'innovations réussies en matière de recrutement.

• Identifier les nouvelles technologies, les tendances de l'industrie et les approches de recrutement qui renforcent la capacité organisationnelle et le leadership en matière d'innovation.

• Servir d'expert fiable, influencer la stratégie, renforcer les capacités et représenter Novartis dans l'écosystème de recherche clinique.

Exigences essentielles

• Diplôme d'études supérieures en sciences de la vie, en soins de santé ou dans une discipline connexe, ou formation et expérience équivalentes pertinentes.

• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience en innovation ou en prestation de solutions, en particulier dans le recrutement d'essais cliniques.

• Au moins sept ans d'expérience dans le développement de médicaments cliniques pharmaceutiques et une bonne compréhension des opérations d'essais cliniques.

• Expertise en recrutement de patients numériques éprouvée, y compris l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de marketing numérique pour identifier et mobiliser les participants potentiels aux essais.

• Expérience de l'application d'outils numériques et de méthodes fondées sur l'intelligence artificielle au recrutement, à la sélection ou à l'appariement des patients dans les essais cliniques.

• Connaissance approfondie des processus de développement clinique, des exigences réglementaires et des bonnes pratiques cliniques.

• Une réussite démontrée traduisant la stratégie en programmes et projets interfonctionnels dans un environnement matriciel mondial complexe.

• Gestion de projet solide, capacité d'influence et de résolution de problèmes, avec autonomie et agilité pour naviguer l'ambiguïté et défier les approches établies.

Salary Range:
CHF207,900.00 - CHF386,100.00

Job Description Summary
The Global Journey Head, Hire & Move is a senior leader within the People & Organization Products & Experience (HR) organization, with strategic responsibility for the Hire & Move product grouping and the end-to-end employee and manager journeys it enables. The role leads the Product Owners accountable for Talent Attraction, Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Internal Mobility, Global Mobility, Executive Scouting and External Workforce, ensuring journey coherence, portfolio health, disciplined investment and value realization. The portfolio is focused on attracting and hiring the right talent, integrating new joiners quickly, and enabling movement of employees and external talent across opportunities and locations.

Job Description
#Hybrid

This role can be based in East Hanover (US), London or Basel.
Please apply only once to the appropriate location.

Key Responsibilities:

• Product Grouping Scope. Accountable for the Hire & Move product grouping, comprising: Talent Attraction; Talent Acquisition; Onboarding; Internal Mobility; Global Mobility; Executive Scouting; External Workforce. The role ensures these products operate as a coherent portfolio and collectively deliver the intended journey outcomes.

• Leadership Team Contribution. Key and active member of the People Experience Leadership Team, together defining and driving the Novartis People Experience ambition, strategy and enterprise priorities.

• Journey Strategy, Vision & Coherence. Own the multi-year ambition for the journeys enabled by the product grouping and translate company strategy, workforce priorities and Expertise Hub direction into coherent journey outcomes. Align Product Owners and partners around the best end-to-end result while preserving Product Owner accountability for individual product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle.

• End User Insight & Business Outcome Definition. Maintain a deep, current and structured understanding of user needs across the portfolio. Sponsor human-centered discovery, use listening and external benchmarks, and define measurable business outcomes that govern portfolio choices.

• Technology Portfolio Plan & Simplification. Work in partnership with the strategy & innovations team to define and drive the automation, AI and agentification strategy across the journey portfolio. Ensure the optimal balance between digital self-service, intelligent agents, automation and human interaction to improve experience, efficiency, compliance and business outcomes while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight. Define the business outcomes, priorities and value expectations that guide the product grouping technology roadmap with PTDI and DDIT. Identify fragmentation, duplication, technical debt, integration gaps and data constraints and prioritize simplification.

• Expertise Hub Partnership & Strategic Priority Translation. Act as the primary portfolio relationship owner with relevant Expertise Hubs. Translate functional strategy, policy and standards into coherent portfolio choices and enable Product Owners to evolve products within agreed guardrails.

• Product Portfolio Strategy, Governance & Lifecycle. Lead the portfolio of Product Owners and own portfolio strategy, composition and health. Establish common product cadences, align roadmaps, arbitrate priorities and recommend investment, acceleration, simplification, consolidation, replacement or retirement.

• Journey, Portfolio KPI & Financial Value Stewardship. Own the KPI and value-realization framework, portfolio cost and investment view, and cross-product indicators. Make or recommend capacity and financial trade-offs so resources are directed toward the greatest benefit and strategic alignment.

• Controls Architecture. Ensure every product has appropriate regulatory, policy, data privacy and process controls, that controls are regularly tested, and that material failures are surfaced and addressed.

What you'll bring to the role
Essential Criteria:

• Extensive Senior P&O(HR) leadership background with breadth across domains across P&O, product, experience or technology-enabled transformation, including significant senior-level responsibility in a complex, global organization. Direct experience in more than one P&O domain is desirable; credible exposure through enterprise collaboration and portfolio leadership may provide equivalent breadth. For this product grouping, experience leading or materially shaping parts of the talent acquisition and movement lifecycle, such as talent attraction, recruiting and selection, onboarding, internal mobility, global mobility or external workforce, would be a preference. Experience connecting candidate, employee and manager journeys across organizational and geographic boundaries, improving high-volume and time-sensitive journeys, and delivering measurable outcomes such as quality of hire, hiring speed, candidate experience, time-to-productivity, internal movement or assignment effectiveness would be particularly useful.

• Experience operating across the Expertise Hub–P&O Workforce Strategy–product boundary. Demonstrated experience navigating the intersection between strategic design and product or operational delivery, and building relationships that enable these communities to work together.

• Technology strategy and AI orientation at portfolio level. Experience translating journey and product outcomes into technology priorities and investment choices, with sufficient understanding of AI, automation, data and architecture to assess value and risk with technical experts.

• Product portfolio, financial and governance experience. Experience leading a portfolio of products, programs, workstreams or teams; setting priorities across competing demands; assessing costs and benefits; making resource trade-offs; and holding multiple teams accountable to shared outcomes.

• Change Leadership & Organizational Influence. Shape how Product Owners work, how Expertise Hub partner and how the business experiences P&O. Build coalitions and communicate change narratives that land at executive level.

• People Leadership & Team Building. Build and grow exceptional Product Owners, set standards for product craft and create an evidence-based, end-user-focused culture.

• Senior Stakeholder Influence, CoE Partnership & Product Arbitration. Operate credibly with senior P&O, Expertise Hub, Country People Experience, P&O Business Partner, Finance, PTDI and DDIT leaders, aligning shared outcomes and arbitrating portfolio tensions.

Benefits & Rewards
At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: 207,900.00 - 386,100.00 CHF Annual

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.
The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. Long-term equity awards granted at group level may also be part of your package. Further details will be provided during the application process.

Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics.

Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Why Novartis: Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Join our Novartis Network: Not the right Novartis role for you? Sign up to our talent community to stay connected and learn about suitable career opportunities as soon as they come up: https://talentnetwork.novartis.com/network

Skills Desired
Business Acumen, Change Management, Coaching, Data Analytics, Data-Driven Decision Making, Development Leadership, HR Strategy, Leadership, Organizational Design, Performance Management (PM), Stakeholder Management, Strategic Planning, Talent Management

Descrizione del lavoro
Il Global Journey Head, Hire & Move è un leader senior all'interno dell'organizzazione People & Organization Products & Experience (HR), con responsabilità strategica per il raggruppamento dei prodotti Hire & Move e i viaggi end-to-end dei dipendenti e dei manager che consente. Il ruolo guida i Proprietari del Prodotto responsabili per Talent Attraction, Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Mobilità Interna, Mobilità Globale, Executive Scouting e Workforce Esterno, garantendo coerenza del viaggio, salute del portafoglio, investimenti disciplinati e realizzazione del valore. Il portafoglio si concentra sull'attrazione e l'assunzione del talento giusto, l'integrazione di nuovi soci in modo rapido e l'attivazione di movimenti di dipendenti e talenti esterni attraverso opportunità e luoghi.

Descrizione del lavoro
# Hybrid #

Questo ruolo può essere basato in East Hanover (US), Londra o Basilea.
Si prega di applicare solo una volta alla posizione appropriata.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Gruppo di prodotti Scope. Contabile per il gruppo di prodotti Hire & Move, comprendente: Talent Attraction; Talent Acquisition; Onboarding; Mobilità interna; Mobilità globale; Executive Scouting; Workforce esterna. Il ruolo assicura che questi prodotti funzionino come un portafoglio coerente e diano collettivamente i risultati di viaggio previsti.

• Contributo del Team Leadership. Membro chiave e attivo del People Experience Leadership Team, definendo e guidando l'ambizione, la strategia e le priorità aziendali Novartis People Experience.

• Strategia del viaggio, Visione e coerenza. Proprio l'ambizione pluriennale per i viaggi abilitati dal raggruppamento dei prodotti e tradurre la strategia aziendale, le priorità della forza lavoro e la direzione di Expertise Hub in risultati di viaggio coerenti. Allineare i proprietari di prodotti e i partner intorno al miglior risultato end-to-end, preservando la responsabilità del proprietario di prodotto per la strategia di prodotto individuale, roadmap e ciclo di vita.

• Definizione del risultato dell'utente finale & Business. Mantenere una comprensione profonda, attuale e strutturata delle esigenze degli utenti in tutto il portafoglio. Sponsorizzare la scoperta, utilizzare l'ascolto e i benchmark esterni, e definire risultati aziendali misurabili che governano le scelte del portafoglio.

• Tecnologia Portfolio Plan & Semplificazione. Lavorare in partnership con il team di strategia e innovazioni per definire e guidare la strategia di automazione, AI e di agenteificazione in tutto il portafoglio di viaggio. Assicurare l'equilibrio ottimale tra auto-servizio digitale, agenti intelligenti, automazione e interazione umana per migliorare l'esperienza, l'efficienza, la conformità e i risultati aziendali, mantenendo la governance e la supervisione appropriate. Definire i risultati aziendali, le priorità e le aspettative di valore che guidano la roadmap della tecnologia di raggruppamento dei prodotti con PTDI e DDIT. Identificare la frammentazione, la duplicazione, il debito tecnico, le lacune di integrazione e i vincoli di dati e priorità semplificazione.

• Competenza Hub Partnership & Strategic Priority Translation. Agire come principale proprietario di relazione di portafoglio con i relativi Expertise Hub. Tradurre strategia funzionale, politica e standard in scelte di portafoglio coerente e consentire ai proprietari di prodotto di evolvere i prodotti all'interno di controlli concordati.

• Strategia Portfolio del prodotto, Governance & Lifecycle. Guida il portafoglio di Proprietari di Prodotto e la propria strategia di portafoglio, composizione e salute. Stabilire cadenze di prodotto comuni, allineare roadmap, arbitrare le priorità e raccomandare investimenti, accelerazione, semplificazione, consolidamento, sostituzione o pensionamento.

• Viaggio, Portfolio KPI & Financial Value Stewardship. Proprio il KPI e il quadro di valorizzazione-realizzazione, il costo del portafoglio e la vista degli investimenti, e gli indicatori cross-product. Fare o raccomandare capacità e trade-off finanziari in modo che le risorse siano indirizzate verso il massimo beneficio e l'allineamento strategico.

• Controlla l'architettura. Assicurarsi che ogni prodotto abbia controlli adeguati alle normative, alle politiche, alla privacy dei dati e ai processi, che i controlli siano regolarmente testati, e che i guasti materiali siano superficiali e affrontati.

Cosa porterai al ruolo
Criteri essenziali:

• Extensive Senior P&O(HR) background di leadership con la larghezza di tutti i domini attraverso P&O, prodotto, esperienza o trasformazione tecnologica, tra cui significativa responsabilità di alto livello in un'organizzazione complessa e globale. L'esperienza diretta in più di un dominio P&O è auspicabile; l'esposizione credibile attraverso la collaborazione aziendale e la leadership di portafoglio può fornire larghezza equivalente. Per questo raggruppamento di prodotti, l'esperienza leader o modellare materialmente parti del ciclo di vita di acquisizione di talenti e di movimento, come attrazione di talento, reclutamento e selezione, onboarding, mobilità interna, mobilità globale o forza lavoro esterno, sarebbe una preferenza. Esperienza di collegamento candidati, dipendenti e manager viaggi attraverso confini organizzativi e geografici, migliorare viaggi ad alto volume e tempo-sensibili, e fornire risultati misurabili come la qualità del noleggio, l'assunzione di velocità, l'esperienza del candidato, tempo per-produttività, movimento interno o l'efficienza di assegnazione sarebbe particolarmente utile.

• Esperienza che opera attraverso il confine Expertise Hub–P&O Workforce Strategy–product. Esperienza dimostrata che attraversa l'intersezione tra design strategico e prodotto o consegna operativa, e relazioni di costruzione che permettono a queste comunità di lavorare insieme.

• Strategia tecnologica e orientamento AI a livello di portafoglio. Esperienza di traduzione dei risultati di viaggio e dei prodotti nelle priorità tecnologiche e nelle scelte di investimento, con sufficiente comprensione di AI, automazione, dati e architettura per valutare valore e rischio con esperti tecnici.

• Portafoglio prodotti, esperienza finanziaria e di governance. Esperienza leader di un portafoglio di prodotti, programmi, flussi di lavoro o team; impostazione delle priorità tra le richieste concorrenti; valutazione dei costi e dei benefici; fare trading-off di risorse; e tenere più team responsabili di risultati condivisi.

• Cambia leadership e influenza organizzativa. Forma come i Proprietari del Prodotto lavorano, come Expertise Hub partner e come il business sperimenta P&O. Costruire le coalizioni e comunicare i cambiamenti narrativi che atterrano a livello esecutivo.

• People Leadership & Team Building. Costruire e coltivare eccezionali Proprietari del Prodotto, fissare standard per l'artigianato del prodotto e creare una cultura basata sulle prove, focalizzata sull'utente finale.

• Senior Stakeholder Influence, CoE Partnership & Product Arbitration. Operare credibilmente con i leader P&O senior, Expertise Hub, Country People Experience, P&O Business Partner, Finance, PTDI e DDIT, allineando i risultati condivisi e arbitrando le tensioni del portafoglio.

Job Description Summary
The Global Journey Head, Hire & Move is a senior leader within the People & Organization Products & Experience (HR) organization, with strategic responsibility for the Hire & Move product grouping and the end-to-end employee and manager journeys it enables. The role leads the Product Owners accountable for Talent Attraction, Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Internal Mobility, Global Mobility, Executive Scouting and External Workforce, ensuring journey coherence, portfolio health, disciplined investment and value realization. The portfolio is focused on attracting and hiring the right talent, integrating new joiners quickly, and enabling movement of employees and external talent across opportunities and locations.

Job Description
#Hybrid

This role can be based in East Hanover (US), London or Basel.
Please apply only once to the appropriate location.

Key Responsibilities:

• Product Grouping Scope. Accountable for the Hire & Move product grouping, comprising: Talent Attraction; Talent Acquisition; Onboarding; Internal Mobility; Global Mobility; Executive Scouting; External Workforce. The role ensures these products operate as a coherent portfolio and collectively deliver the intended journey outcomes.

• Leadership Team Contribution. Key and active member of the People Experience Leadership Team, together defining and driving the Novartis People Experience ambition, strategy and enterprise priorities.

• Journey Strategy, Vision & Coherence. Own the multi-year ambition for the journeys enabled by the product grouping and translate company strategy, workforce priorities and Expertise Hub direction into coherent journey outcomes. Align Product Owners and partners around the best end-to-end result while preserving Product Owner accountability for individual product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle.

• End User Insight & Business Outcome Definition. Maintain a deep, current and structured understanding of user needs across the portfolio. Sponsor human-centered discovery, use listening and external benchmarks, and define measurable business outcomes that govern portfolio choices.

• Technology Portfolio Plan & Simplification. Work in partnership with the strategy & innovations team to define and drive the automation, AI and agentification strategy across the journey portfolio. Ensure the optimal balance between digital self-service, intelligent agents, automation and human interaction to improve experience, efficiency, compliance and business outcomes while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight. Define the business outcomes, priorities and value expectations that guide the product grouping technology roadmap with PTDI and DDIT. Identify fragmentation, duplication, technical debt, integration gaps and data constraints and prioritize simplification.

• Expertise Hub Partnership & Strategic Priority Translation. Act as the primary portfolio relationship owner with relevant Expertise Hubs. Translate functional strategy, policy and standards into coherent portfolio choices and enable Product Owners to evolve products within agreed guardrails.

• Product Portfolio Strategy, Governance & Lifecycle. Lead the portfolio of Product Owners and own portfolio strategy, composition and health. Establish common product cadences, align roadmaps, arbitrate priorities and recommend investment, acceleration, simplification, consolidation, replacement or retirement.

• Journey, Portfolio KPI & Financial Value Stewardship. Own the KPI and value-realization framework, portfolio cost and investment view, and cross-product indicators. Make or recommend capacity and financial trade-offs so resources are directed toward the greatest benefit and strategic alignment.

• Controls Architecture. Ensure every product has appropriate regulatory, policy, data privacy and process controls, that controls are regularly tested, and that material failures are surfaced and addressed.

What you'll bring to the role
Essential Criteria:

• Extensive Senior P&O(HR) leadership background with breadth across domains across P&O, product, experience or technology-enabled transformation, including significant senior-level responsibility in a complex, global organization. Direct experience in more than one P&O domain is desirable; credible exposure through enterprise collaboration and portfolio leadership may provide equivalent breadth. For this product grouping, experience leading or materially shaping parts of the talent acquisition and movement lifecycle, such as talent attraction, recruiting and selection, onboarding, internal mobility, global mobility or external workforce, would be a preference. Experience connecting candidate, employee and manager journeys across organizational and geographic boundaries, improving high-volume and time-sensitive journeys, and delivering measurable outcomes such as quality of hire, hiring speed, candidate experience, time-to-productivity, internal movement or assignment effectiveness would be particularly useful.

• Experience operating across the Expertise Hub–P&O Workforce Strategy–product boundary. Demonstrated experience navigating the intersection between strategic design and product or operational delivery, and building relationships that enable these communities to work together.

• Technology strategy and AI orientation at portfolio level. Experience translating journey and product outcomes into technology priorities and investment choices, with sufficient understanding of AI, automation, data and architecture to assess value and risk with technical experts.

• Product portfolio, financial and governance experience. Experience leading a portfolio of products, programs, workstreams or teams; setting priorities across competing demands; assessing costs and benefits; making resource trade-offs; and holding multiple teams accountable to shared outcomes.

• Change Leadership & Organizational Influence. Shape how Product Owners work, how Expertise Hub partner and how the business experiences P&O. Build coalitions and communicate change narratives that land at executive level.

• People Leadership & Team Building. Build and grow exceptional Product Owners, set standards for product craft and create an evidence-based, end-user-focused culture.

• Senior Stakeholder Influence, CoE Partnership & Product Arbitration. Operate credibly with senior P&O, Expertise Hub, Country People Experience, P&O Business Partner, Finance, PTDI and DDIT leaders, aligning shared outcomes and arbitrating portfolio tensions.

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Le Global Journey Head, Hire & Move est un chef de file principal au sein de l'organisation People & Organization Products & Experience (HR), avec la responsabilité stratégique du regroupement des produits Hire & Move et les parcours des employés et des gestionnaires de bout en bout qu'il permet. Ce rôle dirige les propriétaires de produits responsables de l'attraction des talents, de l'acquisition des talents, de l'embarquement, de la mobilité interne, de la mobilité mondiale, du scoutisme exécutif et de l'effectif externe, assurant la cohérence du parcours, la santé du portefeuille, l'investissement discipliné et la réalisation de valeurs. Le portefeuille vise à attirer et à embaucher les bons talents, à intégrer rapidement les nouveaux arrivants et à permettre aux employés et aux talents externes de se déplacer d'une occasion à l'autre.

Description de l'emploi
Hébride

Ce rôle peut être basé à East Hanover (US), Londres ou Bâle.
Veuillez n'appliquer qu'une seule fois à l'endroit approprié.

Principales responsabilités :

• Portée du regroupement des produits. Responsable du regroupement de produits Location & Move, comprenant : Attraction Talent; Acquisition Talent; Inboarding; Mobilité Interne; Mobilité Globale; Scoutisme Exécutif; Main-d'œuvre externe. Le rôle de ces produits permet de fonctionner comme un portefeuille cohérent et d'obtenir collectivement les résultats escomptés.

• Contribution de l'équipe de direction. Membre clé et actif de l'équipe de leadership de People Experience, définissant et dirigeant ensemble l'ambition, la stratégie et les priorités d'entreprise de Novartis People Experience.

• Stratégie de voyage, vision et cohérence. Posséder l'ambition pluriannuelle pour les voyages permise par le groupement de produits et traduire la stratégie de l'entreprise, les priorités de la main-d'œuvre et l'orientation du centre d'expertise en résultats de voyage cohérents. Aligner les propriétaires de produits et les partenaires autour du meilleur résultat de bout en bout tout en préservant la responsabilité des propriétaires de produits pour la stratégie, la feuille de route et le cycle de vie de chaque produit.

• Définition des résultats de l'utilisateur final. Maintenir une compréhension profonde, actuelle et structurée des besoins des utilisateurs dans l'ensemble du portefeuille. Parrainer la découverte centrée sur l'humain, utiliser l'écoute et des repères externes, et définir des résultats opérationnels mesurables qui régissent les choix de portefeuille.

• Plan de portefeuille technologique et simplification. Travailler en partenariat avec l'équipe Stratégie & innovations pour définir et piloter la stratégie d'automatisation, d'IA et d'agentification dans le portefeuille de voyage. Assurer un équilibre optimal entre le libre-service numérique, les agents intelligents, l'automatisation et l'interaction humaine afin d'améliorer l'expérience, l'efficacité, la conformité et les résultats opérationnels tout en maintenant une gouvernance et une surveillance appropriées. Définir les résultats opérationnels, les priorités et les attentes en matière de valeur qui guident la feuille de route technologique du groupe de produits avec le PTDI et le DDIT. Recenser la fragmentation, les doubles emplois, la dette technique, les lacunes en matière d'intégration et les contraintes en matière de données et hiérarchiser la simplification.

• Expertise Hub Partenariat et traduction des priorités stratégiques. Agir en tant que propriétaire principal de la relation de portefeuille avec les centres d'expertise pertinents. Traduire la stratégie fonctionnelle, la politique et les normes en choix de portefeuille cohérents et permettre aux propriétaires de produits d'évoluer au sein de garde-corps convenus.

• Stratégie, gouvernance et cycle de vie du portefeuille de produits. Diriger le portefeuille des propriétaires de produits et leur propre stratégie, composition et santé. Établir des cadences communes de produits, aligner les feuilles de route, arbitrer les priorités et recommander des investissements, des accélérations, des simplifications, des regroupements, des remplacements ou des départs à la retraite.

• Voyage, portefeuille ICR et gestion de la valeur financière. Posséder l'ICP et le cadre de valorisation, la vision du coût et de l'investissement du portefeuille et les indicateurs de produits croisés. Faire ou recommander des compromis en matière de capacité et de finances afin que les ressources soient orientées vers les plus grands avantages et l'alignement stratégique.

• Contrôles Architecture. S'assurer que chaque produit dispose de la réglementation, des politiques, de la confidentialité des données et des contrôles des processus appropriés, que les contrôles sont régulièrement testés et que les défaillances du matériau sont décelées et corrigées.

Ce que vous allez apporter au rôle
Critères essentiels :

• Une vaste expérience de leadership en matière de P et O (RH) à l'échelle des domaines, des produits, de l'expérience ou de la transformation technologique, y compris une importante responsabilité de haut niveau dans une organisation complexe et mondiale. Une expérience directe dans plus d'un domaine P&O est souhaitable; une exposition crédible grâce à la collaboration des entreprises et au leadership de portefeuille peut fournir une portée équivalente. Pour ce groupe de produits, il serait préférable d'avoir l'expérience de diriger ou de façonner matériellement des parties du cycle de vie d'acquisition et de déplacement des talents, comme l'attraction des talents, le recrutement et la sélection, l'embarquement, la mobilité interne, la mobilité mondiale ou la main-d'oeuvre externe. Il serait particulièrement utile de faire le lien entre les déplacements des candidats, des employés et des gestionnaires au-delà des frontières organisationnelles et géographiques, d'améliorer les déplacements à grande échelle et en fonction du temps, et d'obtenir des résultats mesurables tels que la qualité de l'embauche, la vitesse d'embauche, l'expérience des candidats, le temps de production, les déplacements internes ou l'efficacité des affectations.

• Expérience de fonctionnement à l'échelle de la frontière des produits de la Stratégie sur les effectifs du Centre d'expertise–P&O. Job Description Summary
The Next Generation Scientist Program 2027 by Novartis and University of Basel is an intensive internship program for talented and motivated research scientists from low-middle income countries. The 3-month program (01 June to 31 August 2027), hosted at the Novartis research site in Basel, Switzerland, is designed to foster both their scientific and professional development. Novartis will provide a monthly stipend to cover incidentals and basic living expenses. Guided by Novartis mentors, the interns work on a jointly, agreed-upon scientific, clinical research or global health project and participate in a leadership development program. Research projects expose selected scientists to state-of-the-art methodologies and leading experts in their fields, whilst ensuring that the knowledge and expertise gained can be applied within their home institutions.

Job Description
Minimum requirements:

• Enrolled at university as MSc, PhD or MD student in a geography of scope (low- and middle-income country)

• Active participation in all program and training activities expected

• Advanced verbal and written English communication skills

• Ability to work independently and in groups

• Time management and good organizational skills

Research Area:

• Preferred field of studies are across a wide range of Novartis therapeutic and functional areas, including translational science, clinical development, and global health.

• Therapeutic areas include, but are not limited to: Cardiovascular diseases, oncology (breast and prostate cancer), infectious diseases (malaria, dengue, cryptosporidiosis, leishmaniasis, Chagas disease leprosy), sickle cell disease

• Functional areas include, but are not limited to: Drug discovery and clinical research, clinical operations, bioinformatics, data analytics and AI, patient engagement/advocacy, global health (scientific publications and community health initiatives)
