Job Description Summary
Location: Basel, Switzerland #onsite

Role Purpose:
We are looking for a collaborative and scientifically strong professional to take on the role of Drug Product Project Leader (DPPL) across late-phase oral drug product development programs. In this role, you will lead Drug Product technical development activities for assigned projects, ensuring scientific excellence, strong quality awareness, and alignment with overall project objectives.
The role includes developing and implementing robust Drug Product project strategies, including risk assessments, contingency planning, timelines, budgets, and resource plans. It also requires ensuring alignment with internal functions, external partners, governance processes, and project review milestones.
As DPPL, you will lead, coach, and develop high-performing project teams in line with company values and behaviors. The role is expected to foster a collaborative culture, promote knowledge sharing, set clear objectives, and support the growth and performance of team members.
The position will oversee project execution, proactively manage cross-functional interfaces, and communicate project strategy, risks, issues, and critical updates to relevant stakeholders.
Key responsibilities include ensuring high-quality development documentation and contributing to CMC submission packages, filing dossiers, inspection responses, and Health Authority requests. The role also includes acting as author, reviewer, or approver of development documents in accordance with applicable SOPs and development standards.
In addition, the DPPL will drive Make versus Buy strategies and support outsourced activities with external partners, including input into contracts, quality agreements, and third-party supply-related projects.

Job Description
Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Represent DP project teams within TRD sub-teams, providing strong quality awareness, scientific expertise, and technical leadership.

• Develop robust DP project strategies, including contingency planning and risk assessments, while ensuring alignment with internal functions, external partners, and third parties

• Assess, consolidate, and negotiate project resources, timelines, internal and external costs, and lead the budgeting process for DP activities.

• Ensure adherence to project review processes and relevant governance boards, while implementing building on scientific excellence and approved DP strategies within the project team.

• Proactively manage cross-functional project interactions, monitor project plans, ensure timely delivery of key outputs, and oversee high-quality DP development documentation for CMC submissions.

• Understand and integrate scientific insight into how drug substance and excipient properties, formulation design, and process parameters influence product performance, manufacturability, and consistency.

• Support and apply structured, science-based approaches (e.g., quality-by-design, modelling, and digital tools) to enhance understanding, enable informed decision-making, and support consistent and efficient development practices

• Lead, manage, coach, and support DP teams in line with company values and behaviours, fostering collaboration, team spirit, knowledge sharing, and high performance.

What you’ll bring to the role:

• Advanced degree in Pharmaceutical Technology, Powder Process Engineering, or a related scientific field; PhD or equivalent experience is valued.

• Minimum 5+ years of relevant industry experience in the development of pharmaceutical formulations, preferably with broad and profound understanding of development activities and processes in pharmaceutical sciences. (early and late phase development of oral dosage forms).

• Solid understanding of Quality by Design (QbD), regulatory guidelines (ICHQ8, 9 and 10) and biopharmaceutics, with ability to build compliant bridging strategies. Broad and profound understanding of development activities and processes in pharmaceutical sciences. (early and late phase development).

• Excellent leadership, scientific, project management and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex topics clearly and contribute to efficient and aligned teamwork.

• Ability to balance scientific ambition, patient needs, product quality, regulatory expectations, manufacturability, supply reliability, timelines, and cost.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across global development teams, functions, cultures, and organizational boundaries in a complex matrix environment. Brings an open and inclusive mindset, cultural awareness, adaptability, and comfort with ambiguity; builds trusted relationships, listens to and integrates diverse perspectives, influences without formal authority, constructively resolves differences, aligns stakeholders around shared priorities, and communicates transparently to enable timely decisions and shared accountability.

• Demonstrates high ethical standards, sound judgment, quality ownership, transparency, and consistent leadership behaviours, particularly when facing pressure or conflicting objectives.

• Strong knowledge of relevant GLP, GMP regulations and policies.

• A collaborative mindset combined with an interest in improving how work is structured and executed, including the ability to bring clarity, consistency, and efficiency to development activities.

• Strong interpersonal skills, including coaching other and developing people

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: CHF 93,800 to CHF 174,200

The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically.
In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.

The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.

Accessibility and accommodation
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Ubicazione: Basilea, Svizzera #onsite

Scopo del ruolo:
Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista collaborativo e scientificamente forte per assumere il ruolo di Drug Product Project Leader (DPPL) attraverso programmi di sviluppo di prodotti per la droga orale in fase avanzata. In questo ruolo, guiderai le attività di sviluppo tecnico di Drug Product per i progetti assegnati, garantendo l'eccellenza scientifica, la forte consapevolezza della qualità e l'allineamento con gli obiettivi globali del progetto.
Il ruolo include lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di robuste strategie di progetto del prodotto della droga, comprese le valutazioni del rischio, la pianificazione della contingenza, le linee temporali, i bilanci e i piani delle risorse. Richiede anche garantire l'allineamento con funzioni interne, partner esterni, processi di governance e pietre miliari di revisione del progetto.
Come DPPL, guiderai, coach e svilupperai team di progetto altamente performanti in linea con i valori e i comportamenti aziendali. Il ruolo dovrebbe favorire una cultura collaborativa, promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze, fissare obiettivi chiari e sostenere la crescita e le prestazioni dei membri del team.
La posizione supervisionerà l'esecuzione del progetto, gestirà proattivamente interfacce interfunzionali e comunicherà strategia di progetto, rischi, problemi e aggiornamenti critici per le parti interessate.
Le responsabilità chiave includono garantire una documentazione di sviluppo di alta qualità e contribuire a pacchetti di presentazione CMC, file di archiviazione, risposte di ispezione e richieste dell'Autorità sanitaria. Il ruolo include anche l'azione di autore, recensore o approvazione di documenti di sviluppo in conformità con le SOP e gli standard di sviluppo applicabili.
Inoltre, il DPPL guiderà le strategie Make versus Buy e supporterà le attività outsourced con partner esterni, inclusi gli input in contratti, accordi di qualità e progetti correlati alla fornitura di terze parti.

Descrizione del lavoro
Le tue responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Rappresentate i team di progetto DP all'interno dei sottoteam TRD, fornendo una forte consapevolezza della qualità, competenze scientifiche e leadership tecnica.

• Sviluppare robuste strategie di progetto DP, tra cui la pianificazione della contingenza e le valutazioni dei rischi, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con funzioni interne, partner esterni e terze parti

• Valutare, consolidare e negoziare le risorse del progetto, le linee temporali, i costi interni ed esterni, e condurre il processo di bilancio per le attività del DP.

• Assicurare l'adesione ai processi di revisione del progetto e ai relativi comitati di governance, mentre implementare la costruzione su eccellenza scientifica e le strategie DP approvate all'interno del team di progetto.

• Proattivamente gestire interazioni di progetto interfunzionali, monitorare i piani di progetto, garantire la consegna tempestiva di uscite chiave, e supervisionare la documentazione di sviluppo DP di alta qualità per le presentazioni CMC.

• Comprendere e integrare la comprensione scientifica su come la sostanza della droga e le proprietà eccipienti, la progettazione della formulazione e i parametri di processo influenzano le prestazioni del prodotto, la maniufacturability e la consistenza.

• Supporto e applicazione di approcci strutturati e basati sulla scienza (ad esempio, qualità per design, modellazione e strumenti digitali) per migliorare la comprensione, consentire il processo decisionale informato e sostenere pratiche di sviluppo coerenti ed efficienti

• Guidare, gestire, allenare e supportare i team DP in linea con i valori e i comportamenti aziendali, promuovendo la collaborazione, lo spirito di squadra, la condivisione delle conoscenze e le prestazioni elevate.

Ciò che porterai al ruolo:

• Laurea avanzata in tecnologia farmaceutica, ingegneria del processo della polvere, o un campo scientifico correlato; dottorato o esperienza equivalente è valutato.

• Minimo 5+ anni di esperienza industriale rilevante nello sviluppo di formulazioni farmaceutiche, preferibilmente con ampia e profonda comprensione delle attività e dei processi di sviluppo nelle scienze farmaceutiche. (sviluppo di fase iniziale e tardiva delle forme di dosaggio orale).

• Solida comprensione di Qualità per Design (QbD), linee guida normative (ICHQ8, 9 e 10) e biofarmaci, con la capacità di costruire strategie di bridging conformi. Ampia e profonda comprensione delle attività e dei processi di sviluppo nelle scienze farmaceutiche. (sviluppo di fase iniziale e tardiva).

• Ottima capacità di leadership, scienza, gestione del progetto e di presentazione, con la capacità di trasmettere argomenti complessi in modo chiaro e contribuire a un lavoro di squadra efficiente e allineato.

• Capacità di bilanciare l'ambizione scientifica, le esigenze del paziente, la qualità del prodotto, le aspettative di regolamentazione, la manufacturability, l'affidabilità della fornitura, le tempistiche e i costi.

Role Purpose:
We are looking for a collaborative and scientifically strong professional to take on the role of Drug Product Project Leader (DPPL) across late-phase oral drug product development programs. It also requires ensuring alignment with internal functions, external partners, governance processes, and project review milestones.
As DPPL, you will lead, coach, and develop high-performing project teams in line with company values and behaviors. The role is expected to foster a collaborative culture, promote knowledge sharing, set clear objectives, and support the growth and performance of team members.
The position will oversee project execution, proactively manage cross-functional interfaces, and communicate project strategy, risks, issues, and critical updates to relevant stakeholders.
Key responsibilities include ensuring high-quality development documentation and contributing to CMC submission packages, filing dossiers, inspection responses, and Health Authority requests. The role also includes acting as author, reviewer, or approver of development documents in accordance with applicable SOPs and development standards.
In addition, the DPPL will drive Make versus Buy strategies and support outsourced activities with external partners, including input into contracts, quality agreements, and third-party supply-related projects.

Job Description
Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

• Represent DP project teams within TRD sub-teams, providing strong quality awareness, scientific expertise, and technical leadership.

• Develop robust DP project strategies, including contingency planning and risk assessments, while ensuring alignment with internal functions, external partners, and third parties

• Assess, consolidate, and negotiate project resources, timelines, internal and external costs, and lead the budgeting process for DP activities.

• Proactively manage cross-functional project interactions, monitor project plans, ensure timely delivery of key outputs, and oversee high-quality DP development documentation for CMC submissions.

• Understand and integrate scientific insight into how drug substance and excipient properties, formulation design, and process parameters influence product performance, manufacturability, and consistency.

• Support and apply structured, science-based approaches (e.g., quality-by-design, modelling, and digital tools) to enhance understanding, enable informed decision-making, and support consistent and efficient development practices

• Lead, manage, coach, and support DP teams in line with company values and behaviours, fostering collaboration, team spirit, knowledge sharing, and high performance.

Broad and profound understanding of development activities and processes in pharmaceutical sciences. (early and late phase development).

• Excellent leadership, scientific, project management and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex topics clearly and contribute to efficient and aligned teamwork.

• Ability to balance scientific ambition, patient needs, product quality, regulatory expectations, manufacturability, supply reliability, timelines, and cost.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across global development teams, functions, cultures, and organizational boundaries in a complex matrix environment. • Strong interpersonal skills, including coaching other and developing people

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un professionnel coopératif et scientifiquement fort pour assumer le rôle de chef de projet sur les produits pharmaceutiques (DPPL) dans les programmes de développement des produits pharmaceutiques oraux en phase tardive. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les activités de développement technique des produits pharmaceutiques pour les projets assignés, en assurant l'excellence scientifique, une forte sensibilisation à la qualité et l'alignement sur les objectifs généraux du projet.
Ce rôle comprend l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de projets robustes pour les produits pharmaceutiques, y compris des évaluations des risques, des plans d'urgence, des échéanciers, des budgets et des plans de ressources. Il faut également assurer l'alignement avec les fonctions internes, les partenaires externes, les processus de gouvernance et les étapes de l'examen des projets.
En tant que DPPL, vous dirigerez, coacherez et développerez des équipes de projet performantes en fonction des valeurs et des comportements de l'entreprise. Le rôle devrait favoriser une culture de collaboration, promouvoir le partage des connaissances, fixer des objectifs clairs et appuyer la croissance et le rendement des membres de l'équipe.
Le poste supervisera l'exécution du projet, gérera de façon proactive les interfaces interfonctionnelles et communiquera la stratégie du projet, les risques, les enjeux et les mises à jour critiques aux intervenants concernés.
Les principales responsabilités comprennent l'obtention de documents d'élaboration de haute qualité et la contribution aux dossiers de présentation, au dépôt des dossiers, aux réponses aux inspections et aux demandes des autorités sanitaires. Le rôle consiste également à agir en tant qu'auteur, examinateur ou ordonnateur des documents d'élaboration conformément aux SOP et aux normes d'élaboration applicables.
De plus, la DPPL dirigera des stratégies Make versus Buy et appuiera des activités sous-traitées avec des partenaires externes, y compris la participation à des contrats, des ententes de qualité et des projets de fournisseurs tiers.

Description de l'emploi
Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment :

• Représenter les équipes de projet du PDD au sein des sous-équipes de la DRT, en assurant une forte sensibilisation à la qualité, une expertise scientifique et un leadership technique.

• Élaborer des stratégies de projet robustes, y compris la planification d'urgence et l'évaluation des risques, tout en assurant l'harmonisation avec les fonctions internes, les partenaires externes et les tiers

• Évaluer, consolider et négocier les ressources du projet, les délais, les coûts internes et externes et diriger le processus de budgétisation des activités du PDD.

• Comprendre et intégrer les connaissances scientifiques sur la façon dont la substance médicamenteuse et les propriétés des excipients, la conception de la formulation et les paramètres du processus influent sur la performance, la fabrication et la consistance du produit.

• Soutenir et appliquer des approches structurées et fondées sur la science (p. ex., qualité par conception, modélisation et outils numériques) pour améliorer la compréhension, permettre la prise de décisions éclairées et appuyer des pratiques de développement cohérentes et efficaces

• Diriger, gérer, coacher et soutenir les équipes du PDD conformément aux valeurs et aux comportements de l'entreprise, favoriser la collaboration, l'esprit d'équipe, le partage des connaissances et la haute performance.

Ce que vous apporterez au rôle :

• Diplôme avancé en technologie pharmaceutique, en génie des procédés en poudre ou dans un domaine scientifique connexe; une expérience de doctorat ou une expérience équivalente est appréciée.

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience de l'industrie dans le développement de formulations pharmaceutiques, de préférence avec une compréhension large et profonde des activités et des processus de développement en sciences pharmaceutiques. (développement précoce et tardif des formes posologiques orales).

Connaissance étendue et approfondie des activités et des processus de développement en sciences pharmaceutiques. (début et fin du développement).

• Excellent leadership, compétences scientifiques, gestion de projet et présentation, avec la capacité de transmettre des sujets complexes clairement et de contribuer à un travail d'équipe efficace et harmonisé.

• Capacité d'équilibrer l'ambition scientifique, les besoins des patients, la qualité du produit, les attentes réglementaires, la fabrication, la fiabilité de l'offre, les délais et les coûts.

• Capacité démontrée de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes, les fonctions, les cultures et les frontières organisationnelles du développement mondial dans un environnement matriciel complexe. Amène une mentalité ouverte et inclusive, une conscience culturelle, une adaptabilité et un confort avec ambiguïté; établit des relations de confiance, écoute et intègre diverses perspectives, influences sans autorité formelle, règle de façon constructive les différences, harmonise les intervenants avec les priorités partagées, et communique de façon transparente pour permettre des décisions opportunes et une responsabilité partagée.

• Bonne connaissance des BPL, des règlements et des politiques sur les BPF.

• Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles, y compris l'encadrement d'autres personnes et le perfectionnement

- Evaluation of new packaging modalities (e.g., pre-filled syringes, cartridges)

- Development of Raman spectroscopy-based models using Python for real-time impurity monitoring

Contribute to lab-based (80 %) and office-based (20 %) TRD-biologics projects

Collaborate with internal and external development partners and stakeholders
Acquire an understanding of the TRD-Biologics organizations and how the different units within work together

Education: Master’s degree or equivalent (PhDs will not be considered).
Languages: Fluent in English

In a world where external dynamics can shape business success overnight, intelligence has never been more critical. As Director, Corporate Affairs Intelligence, Strategic Insights, you will help Novartis anticipate change, interpret complexity, and make smarter strategic decisions. This is a rare opportunity to influence how senior stakeholders understand the external environment and translate emerging trends, issues, and opportunities into meaningful action. Working at the intersection of intelligence, strategy, and Corporate Affairs, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, helping shape decisions that impact our business, reputation, and ultimately the patients we serve. If you are energized by turning complex analysis into enterprise intelligence, strategic counsel, and meaningful action and thrive in highly visible, enterprise-level environments, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities

• Lead strategic intelligence initiatives that inform critical Corporate Affairs and enterprise decisions.

• Transform complex analysis into compelling insights, implications, and recommendations for senior leaders.

• Connect external developments to business priorities, identifying risks, opportunities, and strategic actions.

• Develop enterprise-level perspectives that help shape Corporate Affairs strategy and decision-making.

• Translate organizational priorities into intelligence questions that focus attention on what matters most.

• Partner with senior stakeholders to provide trusted counsel on emerging external dynamics.

• Identify intelligence gaps and anticipate developments with potential business or reputational impact.

• Facilitate cross-functional alignment and connect intelligence across business priorities, external developments, and individual analyses.

• Strengthen intelligence capabilities, methodologies, and ways of working across the function.

• Coach and develop colleagues’ capabilities in business partnership, enterprise interpretation, strategic leadership, and senior counsel.

Essential Requirements

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced business degree preferred.

• Extensive experience in strategic intelligence, management consulting, corporate strategy, or a related field.

• Proven ability to translate complex information into strategic insights and executive recommendations.

• Experience partnering with and influencing senior leaders in complex, matrixed organizations.

• Strong understanding of Corporate Affairs, communications, public affairs, policy, or reputation management.

• Pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry experience with strong business and external environment acumen.

• Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts.

• Demonstrated success building trusted relationships and influencing outcomes without formal authority.

• AI fluency and the ability to apply AI-native ways of working responsibly.

Benefits & Rewards

At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Novartis non è in grado di offrire il supporto di trasferimento: si prega di applicare solo se accessibile.

In un mondo in cui le dinamiche esterne possono plasmare il successo del business durante la notte, l'intelligenza non è mai stata più critica. Come Direttore, Corporate Affairs Intelligence, Strategic Insights, aiuterà Novartis anticipare il cambiamento, interpretare la complessità e prendere decisioni strategiche più intelligenti. Questa è una rara opportunità per influenzare come gli stakeholder senior capiscono l'ambiente esterno e traducono tendenze, problemi e opportunità emergenti in azioni significative. Lavorando all'intersezione dell'intelligenza, della strategia e degli affari aziendali, servirai come consulente affidabile per gli stakeholder senior, aiutando le decisioni di forma che influenzano il nostro business, la nostra reputazione e, infine, i pazienti che serviamo. Se siete eccitati trasformando l'analisi complessa in intelligenza aziendale, consiglio strategico, e azione significativa e prosperare in ambienti altamente visibili, a livello aziendale, ci piacerebbe sentire da voi.

Descrizione del lavoro
Principali responsabilità

• Guida iniziative strategiche di intelligenza che informano gli affari aziendali critici e le decisioni aziendali.

• Trasformare l'analisi complessa in approfondimenti, implicazioni e raccomandazioni convincenti per i leader senior.

• Collegare gli sviluppi esterni alle priorità aziendali, identificare i rischi, le opportunità e le azioni strategiche.

• Sviluppare prospettive a livello aziendale che aiutano a plasmare la strategia aziendale e il processo decisionale.

• Tradurre le priorità organizzative in domande di intelligenza che concentrano l'attenzione su ciò che più conta.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder senior per fornire consigli affidabili sulle dinamiche esterne emergenti.

• Identificare le lacune dell'intelligenza e anticipare gli sviluppi con potenziale impatto commerciale o reputazionale.

• Facilitare l'allineamento interfunzionale e collegare l'intelligenza tra le priorità aziendali, gli sviluppi esterni e le analisi individuali.

• Rafforzare le capacità di intelligenza, le metodologie e i modi di lavorare attraverso la funzione.

• Coach e sviluppare le capacità dei colleghi nel partenariato aziendale, interpretazione aziendale, leadership strategica e senior counsel.

Requisiti essenziali

• Corso di laurea richiesto; avanzato corso di laurea preferito.

• Ampia esperienza in intelligenza strategica, consulenza gestionale, strategia aziendale, o un campo correlato.

• Prova capacità di tradurre informazioni complesse in insight strategici e raccomandazioni esecutive.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con e influenzare i leader senior in organizzazioni complesse e matrici.

• Forte comprensione degli affari aziendali, delle comunicazioni, degli affari pubblici, della politica o della gestione della reputazione.

• Esperienza farmaceutica o biofarmaceutica dell'industria con forte acume aziendale ed ambientale esterno.

• Straordinarie capacità di narrazione e comunicazione, con la capacità di semplificare concetti complessi.

• Dimostrato successo costruire relazioni fidate e influenzare i risultati senza autorità formale.

• La fluidità dell'intelligenza artificiale e la capacità di applicare sensi AI-native di lavorare responsabilmente.

Vantaggi e premi

A Novartis, ci impegniamo a riimmaginare insieme la medicina e a premiare le persone che lo fanno accadere.

Le ricompense di far parte del nostro team vanno ben oltre la retribuzione base e gli incentivi. Offriamo anche una varietà di vantaggi competitivi in genere per aiutare a prosperare personalmente e professionalmente, come piani di assicurazione, piani di pensionamento, risorse di benessere e programmi di riconoscimento globale. Inoltre, forniamo opzioni di lavoro flessibili e ibride, dove possibile, e minimo 14 settimane congedo parentale pagato.

#LI-Hybrid

Dans un monde où la dynamique externe peut façonner le succès des entreprises du jour au lendemain, l'intelligence n'a jamais été aussi critique. En tant que directeur, Affaires générales, Renseignements stratégiques, vous aiderez Novartis à anticiper le changement, à interpréter la complexité et à prendre des décisions stratégiques plus intelligentes. Il s'agit d'une occasion rare d'influencer la façon dont les intervenants supérieurs comprennent l'environnement externe et de traduire les nouvelles tendances, questions et possibilités en mesures significatives. En travaillant à l'intersection du renseignement, de la stratégie et des affaires générales, vous serez un conseiller de confiance auprès des principaux intervenants, aidant à façonner les décisions qui influent sur notre entreprise, notre réputation et, en fin de compte, sur les patients que nous servons. Si vous êtes énergisé en transformant l'analyse complexe en intelligence d'entreprise, conseils stratégiques et action significative et prospèrez dans des environnements très visibles, au niveau de l'entreprise, nous aimerions entendre de vous.

Description de l'emploi
Principales responsabilités

• Diriger les initiatives de renseignement stratégique qui éclairent les affaires ministérielles critiques et les décisions d'entreprise.

• Transformer l'analyse complexe en idées, implications et recommandations convaincantes pour les hauts dirigeants.

• Relier les développements externes aux priorités des entreprises, en identifiant les risques, les possibilités et les actions stratégiques.

• Élaborer des perspectives au niveau de l'entreprise qui aident à façonner la stratégie et la prise de décisions en matière d'affaires d'entreprise.

• Traduire les priorités organisationnelles en questions de renseignement qui mettent l'accent sur ce qui compte le plus.

• Établir des partenariats avec des intervenants supérieurs pour fournir des conseils fiables sur les dynamiques externes émergentes.

• Identifier les lacunes en matière de renseignement et prévoir les développements susceptibles d'avoir des répercussions sur les activités ou la réputation.

• Faciliter l'harmonisation interfonctionnelle et relier les renseignements entre les priorités opérationnelles, les développements externes et les analyses individuelles.

• Renforcer les capacités, les méthodologies et les façons de travailler dans l'ensemble de la fonction.

• Encadrer et développer des collègues en partenariat d'affaires, en interprétation d'entreprise, en leadership stratégique et en conseil supérieur.

• Baccalauréat requis; diplôme d'affaires avancé préféré.

• Une vaste expérience en renseignement stratégique, conseil en gestion, stratégie d'entreprise ou domaine connexe.

• Capacité éprouvée de traduire l'information complexe en idées stratégiques et en recommandations de la direction.

• Expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biopharmaceutique avec une forte activité commerciale et l'environnement externe.

• Compétences exceptionnelles en narration et communication, avec la capacité de simplifier des concepts complexes.

• La réussite démontrée établit des relations de confiance et influe sur les résultats sans autorité officielle.

• La fluidité de l'IA et la capacité d'appliquer les méthodes de travail de façon responsable.

Job Description Summary
The Director, Portfolio Analytics leads major portfolio analytics workstreams that inform enterprise, franchise, TA, and senior leadership decisions. The role shapes analytical approaches, interprets portfolio-level implications, advises stakeholders on value and trade-offs, and ensures PDA’s portfolio insights are rigorous, timely, strategically framed, and actionable.

Job Description
CORE PDA FOUNDATION
All PDA roles share a common foundation of analytical rigor, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and clear communication. The differences between Portfolio Analytics and Decision Analytics lie in the primary context and stakeholder model, while the differences between Associate Director and Director lie in scope, autonomy, influence, and impact. Common characteristics are:

• Demonstrates strong analytical rigor, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and clear communication.

• Uses common PDA tools, methods, assumptions, templates, and capability standards.

• Supports TA-aligned PDA collaboration across Portfolio Analytics and Decision Analytics.

• Converts complex analytics into concise insight and practical recommendations for decision-makers.
ROLE-SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead major portfolio analytics workstreams, including portfolio reviews, long-range portfolio assessments, prioritization exercises, TA/franchise analyses, and enterprise-level portfolio decision support.

• Shape analytical methodologies for portfolio prioritization, valuation, risk, scenario planning, pipeline sizing, value optimization, and related portfolio decision questions.

• Provide senior stakeholders with clear interpretation of portfolio dynamics, risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and implications for investment, prioritization, and strategic planning.

• Serve as a senior PDA thought partner for enterprise, franchise, TA, and EPI stakeholders.

• Lead development of senior-ready materials that synthesize complex portfolio analyses into clear recommendations and decision narratives.

• Mentor Associate Directors and other PDA colleagues in analytical framing, communication, stakeholder management, and portfolio methodology.

• Drive continuous improvement of PDA tools, systems, reporting, and analytical standards.
LEVEL-SPECIFIC EXPECTATIONS

• Owns complex, high-impact analytical workstreams from problem framing through stakeholder communication.

• Operates with significant independence and judgment in ambiguous or high-stakes situations.

• Shapes the analytical agenda, not only responds to requested analyses.

• Influences senior stakeholders by connecting data, assumptions, trade-offs, and strategic choices.

• Coaches others and advances PDA capabilities through development of reusable methodologies, tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the function beyond a single deliverable.
CAPABILITIES AND EXPERIENCE

• Degree in business (MBA preferred) or an advanced scientific degree

• Proficiency in English (written and verbal) is required

• Significant pharmaceutical industry experience with exposure to research, development and/or commercialization processes

• Deep experience with R&D portfolio analytics, valuation, forecasting, prioritization, scenario planning, or related strategic analytics.

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical R&D, portfolio strategy, asset value drivers, risk, development trade-offs, and enterprise decision processes.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex analyses and convert them into senior-level recommendations.

• Ability to influence in a matrixed environment without formal authority.

• Track record of improving analytical methods, tools, processes, or team capabilities.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:
Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Accessibility and Accommodation:
Novartis is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to all individuals. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to receive more detailed information about the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversity.inclusion_ch@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Please include the job requisition number in your message.

Skills Desired
Account Management, Business Development, Business Planning, Drug Development, Financial Modeling, IT Portfolio Management, Key Account Management, Leadership, Market Share, Portfolio Analysis, Prioritization, Product Positioning, Profit and Loss (P&L), Waterfall Model

Descrizione del lavoro
Il Direttore, Portfolio Analytics guida importanti flussi di lavoro di analisi del portafoglio che informano le decisioni aziendali, di franchising, TA e di leadership senior. Il ruolo forma approcci analitici, interpreta le implicazioni a livello di portafoglio, consiglia le parti interessate sul valore e i trade-off, e assicura che gli insight del portafoglio di PDA siano rigorosi, tempestivi, strategicamente inquadrati e attuabili.

Descrizione del lavoro
FONDAZIONE PDA CORE
Tutti i ruoli PDA condividono una base comune di rigore analitico, pensiero strategico, gestione degli stakeholder e comunicazione chiara. Le differenze tra Portfolio Analytics e Decision Analytics si trovano nel contesto primario e nel modello di stakeholder, mentre le differenze tra Direttore e Direttore Associato sono di portata, autonomia, influenza e impatto. Le caratteristiche comuni sono:

• Dimostra forte rigore analitico, pensiero strategico, gestione degli stakeholder e comunicazione chiara.

• Utilizza strumenti, metodi, presupposti, modelli e standard di funzionalità PDA comuni.

• Supporta la collaborazione PDA integrata in Portfolio Analytics e Decision Analytics.

• Converte analisi complesse in comprensione concisa e raccomandazioni pratiche per i decisori.
ROLE-SPECIFICAZIONI

• Lead major portfolio analytics workstreams, tra cui recensioni di portafoglio, valutazioni di portafoglio a lungo raggio, esercizi di priorità, analisi TA/franchise e supporto decisionale di portafoglio a livello aziendale.

• Forma metodologie analitiche per priorità del portafoglio, valutazione, rischio, pianificazione dello scenario, dimensionamento pipeline, ottimizzazione del valore e relative domande di decisione del portafoglio.

• Fornire agli stakeholder senior una chiara interpretazione della dinamica del portafoglio, dei rischi, delle opportunità, dei trade-off e delle implicazioni per gli investimenti, la priorità e la pianificazione strategica.

• Servire come partner di pensiero PDA senior per le parti interessate di impresa, franchising, TA e EPI.

• Sviluppo di materiali di alto livello che sintetizzano il portafoglio complesso analizza in chiare raccomandazioni e narrazioni decisionali.

• Mentor Associate Directors e altri colleghi del PDA nell'inquadratura analitica, nella comunicazione, nella gestione degli stakeholder e nella metodologia del portafoglio.

• Miglioramento continuo di strumenti, sistemi, report e standard analitici PDA.
ESPETTIVE LEVEL-SPECIFICHE

• Possiede flussi di lavoro analitici complessi e ad alto impatto dall'inquadratura dei problemi attraverso la comunicazione degli stakeholder.

• Funziona con significativa indipendenza e giudizio in situazioni ambigue o di alto livello.

• Forma l'agenda analitica, non solo risponde alle analisi richieste.

• Influenza gli stakeholder senior collegando dati, ipotesi, trade-off e scelte strategiche.

• Allena gli altri e avanza le capacità PDA attraverso lo sviluppo di metodologie riutilizzabili, strumenti, framework e best practice che migliorano la funzione oltre un singolo deliverable.
CAPABILITÀ E ESPERIENZA

• Laurea in economia (MBA preferito) o un grado scientifico avanzato

• La competenza in inglese (scritto e verbale) è richiesta

• Esperienza significativa dell'industria farmaceutica con esposizione ai processi di ricerca, sviluppo e/o commercializzazione

• Esperienza profonda con analisi del portafoglio R&D, valutazione, previsione, priorità, pianificazione degli scenari o analisi strategiche correlate.

• Forte comprensione della R&D farmaceutica, strategia di portafoglio, driver di valore di asset, rischio, trade-off di sviluppo e processi decisionali aziendali.

• Capacità dimostrata di condurre analisi complesse e convertirle in raccomandazioni di alto livello.

• Capacità di influenzare in un ambiente matrixed senza autorità formale.

• Traccia il record di migliorare i metodi analitici, gli strumenti, i processi o le capacità del team.

Impegno alla diversità e all'inclusione:
Novartis si impegna a costruire un ambiente di lavoro eccezionale e inclusivo e diverse squadre rappresentative dei pazienti e delle comunità che serviamo.

Accessibilità e alloggio:
Novartis si impegna a lavorare con e fornire alloggio ragionevole a tutti gli individui. Se, a causa di una condizione medica o disabilità, avete bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di reclutamento, o per ricevere informazioni più dettagliate sulle funzioni essenziali di una posizione, si prega di inviare una e-mail a Diversi.inclusion ch@novartis.com e fateci conoscere la natura della vostra richiesta e le vostre informazioni di contatto. Si prega di includere il numero di richiesta di lavoro nel messaggio.

Competenze desiderate
Gestione account, sviluppo aziendale, pianificazione aziendale, sviluppo della droga, modellazione finanziaria, gestione del portafoglio IT, gestione del conto chiave, leadership, quota di mercato, analisi del portafoglio, priorità, posizionamento del prodotto, profitto e perdita (P&L), modello di cascata

• Verwendet gängige PDA-Tools, Methoden, Annahmen, Vorlagen und Fähigkeitsstandards.

• Unterstützt die TA-orientierte PDA-Zusammenarbeit in Portfolio Analytics und Decision Analytics.

• Konvertiert komplexe Analysen in prägnante Einblicke und praktische Empfehlungen für Entscheidungsträger.
ROLLSPEZIFISCHE VERANTWORTUNGEN

• Führen Sie wichtige Portfolioanalyse-Workstreams, einschließlich Portfolio-Reviews, langfristige Portfolio-Bewertungen, Priorisierungsübungen, TA / Franchise-Analysen und Portfolio-Entscheidungsunterstützung auf Unternehmensebene.

• Formen Sie analytische Methoden für Portfoliopriorisierung, Bewertung, Risiko, Szenarioplanung, Pipeline-Sizing, Wertoptimierung und damit verbundene Portfolioentscheidungsfragen.

• Bereitstellung einer klaren Interpretation der Portfoliodynamik, der Risiken, Chancen, Kompromisse und Implikationen für Investitionen, Priorisierung und strategische Planung.

• Als Senior PDA Thought Partner für Unternehmens-, Franchise-, TA- und EPI-Stakeholder fungieren.

• Führen Sie die Entwicklung von Senior-ready-Materialien, die komplexe Portfolioanalysen zu klaren Empfehlungen und Entscheidungserzählungen zusammenführen.

• Mentor Associate Directors und andere PDA-Kollegen in den Bereichen analytisches Framing, Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und Portfolio-Methodik.

• Führen Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von PDA-Tools, Systemen, Berichten und Analysestandards voran.
LEVELSPEZIFISCHE ERWARTUNGEN

• Besitzt komplexe, hochwirksame analytische Workstreams aus Problemstellungen durch Stakeholder-Kommunikation.

• Funktioniert mit erheblicher Unabhängigkeit und Urteilsvermögen in mehrdeutigen oder High-Stakes-Situationen.

• Gestaltet die analytische Agenda, reagiert nicht nur auf angeforderte Analysen.

• Beeinflusst leitende Stakeholder durch die Verbindung von Daten, Annahmen, Kompromissen und strategischen Entscheidungen.

• Coaching anderer und verbessert die PDA-Fähigkeiten durch die Entwicklung von wiederverwendbaren Methoden, Tools, Frameworks und Best Practices, die die Funktion über ein einziges Ergebnis hinaus verbessern.
KAPAZITÄTEN UND ERFAHRUNGEN

• Abschluss in Business (MBA bevorzugt) oder ein fortgeschrittener wissenschaftlicher Abschluss

• Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich) sind erforderlich

• Bedeutende Erfahrungen der Pharmaindustrie mit Forschungs-, Entwicklungs- und/oder Vermarktungsprozessen

• Tiefe Erfahrung mit R & D-Portfolioanalysen, Bewertung, Prognose, Priorisierung, Szenarioplanung oder damit verbundenen strategischen Analysen.

• Starkes Verständnis für pharmazeutische Forschung und Entwicklung, Portfoliostrategie, Asset Value Treiber, Risiko, Entwicklungskompromisse und Unternehmensentscheidungsprozesse.

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen zu führen und sie in Empfehlungen auf höherer Ebene umzuwandeln.

• Fähigkeit, in einer matrixförmigen Umgebung ohne formale Autorität zu beeinflussen.

• Erfolgsbilanz der Verbesserung der analytischen Methoden, Werkzeuge, Prozesse oder Teamfähigkeiten.

Wenn Sie aufgrund einer Erkrankung oder Behinderung eine angemessene Unterkunft für einen Teil des Rekrutierungsprozesses benötigen oder um detailliertere Informationen über die wesentlichen Funktionen einer Position zu erhalten, senden Sie bitte eine E-Mail an diversity.inclusion ch@novartis.com und teilen Sie uns die Art Ihrer Anfrage und Ihre Kontaktinformationen mit. Bitte geben Sie die Stellenanforderungsnummer in Ihrer Nachricht an.

Account Management, Business Development, Business Planning, Drug Development, Financial Modeling, IT Portfolio Management, Key Account Management, Leadership, Marktanteil, Portfolioanalyse, Priorisierung, Produktpositionierung, Gewinn und Verlust (P&L), Wasserfallmodell

Sommaire de la description d'emploi
Le directeur de Portfolio Analytics dirige d'importants travaux d'analyse de portefeuille qui éclairent les décisions des entreprises, des franchisés, de l'AT et des cadres supérieurs. Le rôle façonne les approches analytiques, interprète les implications au niveau du portefeuille, conseille les intervenants sur la valeur et les compromis, et assure que les connaissances du portefeuille de l'AAP sont rigoureuses, opportunes, structurées stratégiquement et réalisables.

Description de l'emploi
FONDATION DE LA PDA DE BASE
Tous les rôles de la PDA partagent une base commune de rigueur analytique, de réflexion stratégique, de gestion des intervenants et de communication claire. Les différences entre Portfolio Analytics et Decision Analytics se situent dans le contexte principal et le modèle des intervenants, tandis que les différences entre Directeur associé et Directeur se situent dans la portée, l'autonomie, l'influence et l'impact. Les caractéristiques communes sont:

• Démontrer une rigueur analytique forte, une réflexion stratégique, une gestion des intervenants et une communication claire.

• Utilise des outils, des méthodes, des hypothèses, des modèles et des normes de capacité communs en matière de PDA.

• Soutient la collaboration de l'APA dans l'analyse de portefeuille et l'analyse des décisions.

• Transforme l'analyse complexe en un aperçu concis et des recommandations pratiques pour les décideurs.
RESPONSABILITÉS RÔLES SPÉCIFIQUES

• Diriger les principaux volets de l'analyse des portefeuilles, y compris les examens des portefeuilles, les évaluations à long terme des portefeuilles, les exercices de hiérarchisation, les analyses de l'AT/franchise et l'appui à la décision des portefeuilles au niveau de l'entreprise.

• Former des méthodes d'analyse pour la hiérarchisation des portefeuilles, l'évaluation, le risque, la planification des scénarios, le calibrage des pipelines, l'optimisation des valeurs et les questions connexes de décision du portefeuille.

• Fournir aux principaux intervenants une interprétation claire de la dynamique du portefeuille, des risques, des possibilités, des compromis et des répercussions sur les investissements, les priorités et la planification stratégique.

• Servir de partenaire principal de la PDA pour l'entreprise, franchise, TA et EPI parties prenantes.

• Diriger l'élaboration de documents prêts à l'emploi qui synthétisent les analyses complexes du portefeuille en recommandations claires et en descriptions des décisions.

• Mentor Directeurs associés et autres collègues de PDA dans le cadre analytique, la communication, la gestion des intervenants et la méthodologie du portefeuille.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des outils, des systèmes, des rapports et des normes d'analyse de la PDA.
EXPÉTATIONS SPÉCIFIQUES DE NIVEAU

• Posséder des filières d'analyse complexes et à fort impact, depuis l'élaboration des problèmes jusqu'à la communication avec les intervenants.

• Fonctionne avec une indépendance et un jugement importants dans des situations ambiguës ou à fort débit.

• Forme l'ordre du jour analytique, non seulement répond aux analyses demandées.

• Influe sur les intervenants supérieurs en reliant les données, les hypothèses, les compromis et les choix stratégiques.

• Encadre les autres et fait progresser les capacités de PDA en élaborant des méthodologies, des outils, des cadres et des pratiques exemplaires réutilisables qui améliorent la fonction au-delà d'un seul produit livrable.
CAPACITÉS ET EXPÉRIENCE

• Diplôme en affaires (MBA préféré) ou un diplôme scientifique avancé

• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrite et verbale) est requise

• Expérience importante de l'industrie pharmaceutique en matière d'exposition aux processus de recherche, de développement et/ou de commercialisation

• Expérience approfondie de l'analyse du portefeuille de R-D, de l'évaluation, des prévisions, de l'établissement des priorités, de la planification des scénarios ou de l'analyse stratégique connexe.

• Connaissance approfondie de la R-D pharmaceutique, de la stratégie de portefeuille, des facteurs de valeur des actifs, des risques, des compromis en matière de développement et des processus décisionnels des entreprises.

• Capacité démontrée de diriger des analyses complexes et de les convertir en recommandations de haut niveau.

• Capacité d'influencer dans un environnement matriciel sans autorité formelle.

• Faire le suivi de l'amélioration des méthodes, des outils, des processus ou des capacités d'équipe.

Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion :
Novartis s'engage à créer un milieu de travail exceptionnel et inclusif et des équipes diversifiées représentatives des patients et des collectivités que nous servons.

Accessibilité et hébergement:
Novartis s'engage à travailler avec toutes les personnes et à leur offrir des aménagements raisonnables. Si, en raison d'une maladie ou d'un handicap, vous avez besoin d'un aménagement raisonnable pour toute partie du processus de recrutement, ou afin de recevoir des informations plus détaillées sur les fonctions essentielles d'un poste, veuillez envoyer un e-mail à diversity.inclusion ch@novartis.com et nous faire savoir la nature de votre demande et vos coordonnées. Veuillez inclure le numéro de demande d'emploi dans votre message.

Compétences recherchées

Job Description Summary
18. That's the number of months you will spend embedded in Global Discovery Chemistry (GDC) as an Industrial Postdoc, working at the heart of Novartis's most ambitious internal innovation initiative — the Genesis program. We are looking for a highly motivated, bold-thinking postgraduate scientist with expertise in biocatalysis, protein engineering, synthetic biology or a closely related field, ready to develop transformative technology platforms that reshape how medicines are discovered and made.

This is not a conventional postdoc. Genesis is Novartis's flagship internal innovation program — structured as an internal startup within one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies. Think of it as the intellectual challenge and pace of an early-stage biotech, backed by the resources, scientific depth, and pipeline of Novartis Biomedical Research. We will encourage you to move fast, think big, and work on problems that matter — with the support of a world-class interdisciplinary team around you.

This role is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of applied biocatalysis and protein engineering, at the interface between research and development, with direct impact on the Novartis portfolio. You will not only transfer your scientific knowledge into practice — you will develop your leadership skills, build a powerful internal and external network, and lay the foundation for an exceptional career in the pharmaceutical industry or academia.

Job Description
Your Responsibilities
Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Design and develop innovative technology platforms in biocatalysis and protein engineering as part of the Genesis flagship program, advancing Novartis's discovery capabilities at speed.

• Conduct enzyme discovery and engineering campaigns — leveraging latest computational tools and high-throughput automated screening — to identify and optimise novel biocatalysts for pharmaceutical synthesis applications.

• Develop novel biocatalytic synthetic solutions that enable efficient, scalable, and sustainable preparation of drug candidates across novel modalities, from early discovery through to clinical and commercial supply.

• Get exposure to peptide chemistry and display technologies to expand the scope and diversity of biocatalytic solutions available to the Novartis portfolio.

• Apply cutting-edge automation platforms and advanced automation for high-throughput enzyme screening, data-rich experimentation, and rapid iteration across engineering campaigns.

• Contribute to defining scientific strategy on Genesis program projects — identifying bold opportunities, designing novel experimental approaches, and helping shape the direction of the platform.

• Collaborate with world-class experts in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, Process Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, and Analytical Chemistry across Novartis and with external academic and industry partners.

• Communicate your science — present findings internally, contribute to patents, and make complex science accessible to diverse audiences.

What You'll Bring to the Role

• A completed PhD at the interface of Chemistry and Biology with a focus on biocatalysis, synthetic biology, enzyme engineering, or a closely related discipline.

• Hands on experience in development of peptide-, or protein-modifying enzymatic transformations is preferred.

• Strong track record of original research and the ability to develop innovative (bio)catalytic transformations.

• Scientific curiosity and team spirit to effectively work at the interface of multiple scientific disciplines in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• Effective interpersonal and communication skills are essential.

• Effective knowledge of English, both oral and written, is required.

• Experience with state-of-the-art high throughput, computation or display technologies as well as previous post-doctoral experience is a further advantage but not a requirement.

Why Consider Novartis?
750 million. That's how many lives our products touch. And while we're proud of that, in this world of digital and technological transformation, we must also ask ourselves: how can we continue to improve and extend even more people's lives?

We believe the answers are found when curious, courageous, and collaborative people like you are empowered to ask new questions, make bolder decisions, and take smarter risks.

At Novartis Biomedical Research, you will have access to state-of-the-art infrastructure — advanced automation, high-throughput screening, computational design platforms, and structural biology capabilities. You will be mentored by world-class scientists and embedded in a scientific community that spans academic leaders, industry partners, and the Novartis global network. You will publish, present, and file patents. And through the Genesis program, you will experience something that is genuinely rare in large-company R&D: the energy, pace, and creative latitude of a startup, combined with the resources and pipeline of a top-five global pharmaceutical company.

Skills Desired

Descrizione del lavoro
18. Questo è il numero di mesi che trascorrerai incorporato nella Global Discovery Chemistry (GDC) come Postdoc Industriale, lavorando al cuore della più ambiziosa iniziativa di innovazione interna di Novartis — il programma Genesis. Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato post-laurea altamente motivato, con competenze in biocatalisi, ingegneria delle proteine, biologia sintetica o un campo strettamente correlato, pronto a sviluppare piattaforme tecnologiche trasformative che rimodellano come i farmaci vengono scoperti e realizzati.

Questo non è un postdoc convenzionale. Genesis è il fiore all'occhiello programma di innovazione interna di Novartis - strutturato come una startup interna all'interno di una delle principali aziende farmaceutiche del mondo. Consideralo come la sfida intellettuale e il ritmo di una biotecnologia del primo stadio, sostenuta dalle risorse, dalla profondità scientifica e dalla pipeline di Novartis Biomedical Research. Vi incoraggiamo a muoversi velocemente, pensare in grande e lavorare su problemi che importa - con il supporto di un team interdisciplinare di livello mondiale intorno a voi.

Questo ruolo è un'occasione unica per lavorare all'avanguardia della biocatalisi applicata e dell'ingegneria proteica, all'interfaccia tra ricerca e sviluppo, con impatto diretto sul portafoglio Novartis. Non solo trasferire le tue conoscenze scientifiche in pratica - svilupperai le tue capacità di leadership, costruirai una potente rete interna ed esterna, e getterà le basi per una carriera eccezionale nell'industria farmaceutica o nell'accademia.

Descrizione del lavoro
Le tue responsabilità
Le tue responsabilità includono, ma non sono limitate a:

• Progettare e sviluppare piattaforme tecnologiche innovative nella biocatalisi e nell'ingegneria delle proteine nell'ambito del programma di punta Genesis, promuovendo le capacità di scoperta di Novartis a velocità.

• Condurre la scoperta degli enzimi e le campagne di ingegneria — sfruttando gli ultimi strumenti computazionali e lo screening automatizzato ad alto rendimento — per identificare e ottimizzare nuovi biocatalisti per applicazioni di sintesi farmaceutica.

• Sviluppare nuove soluzioni sintetiche biocatalitiche che consentono una preparazione efficiente, scalabile e sostenibile dei candidati alla droga attraverso nuove modalità, dalla scoperta precoce alla fornitura clinica e commerciale.

• Ottenere l'esposizione alla chimica peptide e tecnologie di visualizzazione per espandere la portata e la diversità di soluzioni biocatalitiche disponibili al portafoglio Novartis.

• Applica piattaforme di automazione all'avanguardia e automazione avanzata per lo screening degli enzimi ad alto rendimento, la sperimentazione ricca di dati e la rapida iterazione attraverso campagne di ingegneria.

• Contribuire a definire la strategia scientifica sui progetti di programma Genesis — identificare opportunità audaci, progettare nuovi approcci sperimentali e contribuire a modellare la direzione della piattaforma.

• Collabora con esperti di livello mondiale in biologia molecolare, biochimica, bioinformatica, chimica di processo, ingegneria chimica e chimica analitica in Novartis e con partner accademici e industriali esterni.

• Comunicare la vostra scienza — i risultati attuali internamente, contribuire a brevetti, e rendere la scienza complessa accessibile a pubblico diverso.

Cosa porterai al ruolo

• Un dottorato completato all'interfaccia di Chimica e Biologia con un focus sulla biocatalisi, biologia sintetica, ingegneria degli enzimi, o una disciplina strettamente correlata.

• Le mani sull'esperienza nello sviluppo di peptide-, o le trasformazioni enzimatiche modificanti dalle proteine sono preferite.

• Forte tracciato della ricerca originale e la capacità di sviluppare trasformazioni catalitiche innovative (bio).

• Curiosità scientifica e spirito di squadra per lavorare efficacemente all'interfaccia di molteplici discipline scientifiche in un ambiente multiculturale veloce.

• Sono essenziali competenze interpersonali e di comunicazione efficaci.

• È richiesta una conoscenza efficace dell'inglese, sia orale che scritta.

• L'esperienza con tecnologie ad alto rendimento, calcolo o visualizzazione all'avanguardia e l'esperienza post-doctoral precedente è un ulteriore vantaggio ma non un requisito.

Perché considerare Novartis?
750 milioni. Ecco quante vite toccano i nostri prodotti. E mentre siamo orgogliosi di questo, in questo mondo della trasformazione digitale e tecnologica, dobbiamo anche chiederci: come possiamo continuare a migliorare ed estendere ancora più la vita delle persone?

Crediamo che le risposte si trovano quando persone curiosi, coraggiose e collaborative come te hanno il potere di porre nuove domande, prendere decisioni più audaci, e prendere rischi più intelligenti.

A Novartis Biomedical Research, avrete accesso a infrastrutture all'avanguardia — automazione avanzata, screening ad alto rendimento, piattaforme di progettazione computazionale e capacità di biologia strutturale. Sarete guidati da scienziati di livello mondiale e incorporati in una comunità scientifica che abbraccia leader accademici, partner del settore e la rete globale Novartis. Lei pubblicherà, presente e depositerà brevetti. E attraverso il programma Genesis, si sperimenterà qualcosa che è veramente raro in R&D di grande azienda: l'energia, il ritmo e la latitudine creativa di una startup, combinato con le risorse e pipeline di una società farmaceutica globale top-five.

Competenze desiderate

Stellenbeschreibung Zusammenfassung
18. Das ist die Anzahl der Monate, die Sie als Industrial Postdoc in Global Discovery Chemistry (GDC) verbringen und im Herzen der ehrgeizigsten internen Innovationsinitiative von Novartis arbeiten werden - dem Genesis-Programm. Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten, mutig denkenden postgradualen Wissenschaftler mit Expertise in Biokatalyse, Protein Engineering, synthetischer Biologie oder einem eng verwandten Gebiet, der bereit ist, transformative Technologieplattformen zu entwickeln, die die Art und Weise, wie Medikamente entdeckt und hergestellt werden, neu gestalten.

Dies ist kein konventioneller Postdoc. Genesis ist das führende interne Innovationsprogramm von Novartis - strukturiert als internes Startup in einem der weltweit führenden Pharmaunternehmen. Betrachten Sie es als die intellektuelle Herausforderung und das Tempo eines frühen Biotech, unterstützt durch die Ressourcen, die wissenschaftliche Tiefe und die Pipeline von Novartis Biomedical Research. Wir werden Sie ermutigen, sich schnell zu bewegen, groß zu denken und an wichtigen Problemen zu arbeiten - mit der Unterstützung eines erstklassigen interdisziplinären Teams um Sie herum.

Diese Rolle ist eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Entwicklung an der Spitze der angewandten Biokatalyse und des Protein-Engineering zu arbeiten, mit direkten Auswirkungen auf das Novartis-Portfolio. Sie werden nicht nur Ihre wissenschaftlichen Kenntnisse in die Praxis übertragen - Sie werden Ihre Führungsqualitäten entwickeln, ein leistungsfähiges internes und externes Netzwerk aufbauen und den Grundstein für eine außergewöhnliche Karriere in der Pharmaindustrie oder der Wissenschaft legen.

Stellenbeschreibung
Ihre Aufgaben
Ihre Aufgaben umfassen, sind aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Design und Entwicklung innovativer Technologieplattformen für Biokatalyse und Protein-Engineering als Teil des Genesis-Flaggschiffprogramms, wodurch die Entdeckungsmöglichkeiten von Novartis schnell vorangebracht werden.

• Durchführung von Enzym-Entdeckungs- und Engineering-Kampagnen - unter Nutzung der neuesten Computer-Tools und des automatisierten Hochdurchsatz-Screenings - zur Identifizierung und Optimierung neuartiger Biokatalysatoren für pharmazeutische Syntheseanwendungen.

• Entwicklung neuartiger biokatalytischer synthetischer Lösungen, die eine effiziente, skalierbare und nachhaltige Zubereitung von Wirkstoffkandidaten über neuartige Modalitäten hinweg ermöglichen, von der frühen Entdeckung bis hin zur klinischen und kommerziellen Lieferung.

• Machen Sie sich mit Peptidchemie und Display-Technologien vertraut, um den Umfang und die Vielfalt biokatalytischer Lösungen für das Novartis-Portfolio zu erweitern.

• Wenden Sie modernste Automatisierungsplattformen und fortschrittliche Automatisierung für Enzym-Screening mit hohem Durchsatz, datenreiche Experimente und schnelle Iteration über Engineering-Kampagnen hinweg an.

• Beitrag zur Definition wissenschaftlicher Strategien für Genesis-Programmprojekte - Identifizierung mutiger Möglichkeiten, Entwicklung neuartiger experimenteller Ansätze und Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung der Richtung der Plattform.

• Arbeiten Sie mit erstklassigen Experten für Molekularbiologie, Biochemie, Bioinformatik, Prozesschemie, Chemietechnik und Analytische Chemie in Novartis und mit externen akademischen und industriellen Partnern zusammen.

• Kommunizieren Sie Ihre Wissenschaft - präsentieren Sie Ergebnisse intern, tragen Sie zu Patenten bei und machen Sie komplexe Wissenschaft für verschiedene Zielgruppen zugänglich.

Was Sie zur Rolle bringen werden

• Eine abgeschlossene Promotion an der Schnittstelle von Chemie und Biologie mit Schwerpunkt auf Biokatalyse, synthetischer Biologie, Enzymtechnik oder einer eng verwandten Disziplin.

• Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung von Peptid- oder Protein-modifizierenden enzymatischen Transformationen sind bevorzugt.

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz der ursprünglichen Forschung und die Fähigkeit, innovative (bio)katalytische Transformationen zu entwickeln.

• Wissenschaftliche Neugier und Teamgeist, um effektiv an der Schnittstelle mehrerer wissenschaftlicher Disziplinen in einem schnelllebigen, multikulturellen Umfeld zu arbeiten.

• Wirksame zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sind unerlässlich.

• Effektive Englischkenntnisse, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich, sind erforderlich.

• Erfahrungen mit hochmodernen Hochdurchsatz-, Rechen- oder Anzeigetechnologien sowie bisherige Post-Doc-Erfahrung sind ein weiterer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Warum Novartis?
750 Millionen. So viele Leben berühren unsere Produkte. Und obwohl wir stolz darauf sind, müssen wir uns in dieser Welt des digitalen und technologischen Wandels auch fragen: Wie können wir das Leben von noch mehr Menschen weiter verbessern und verlängern?

Wir glauben, dass die Antworten gefunden werden, wenn neugierige, mutige und kooperative Menschen wie Sie befähigt werden, neue Fragen zu stellen, mutigere Entscheidungen zu treffen und intelligentere Risiken einzugehen.

Bei Novartis Biomedical Research haben Sie Zugang zu modernster Infrastruktur - fortschrittliche Automatisierung, Hochdurchsatz-Screening, Computer-Design-Plattformen und strukturelle Biologiefähigkeiten. Sie werden von Weltklasse-Wissenschaftlern betreut und in eine wissenschaftliche Gemeinschaft eingebettet, die führende Wissenschaftler, Industriepartner und das globale Netzwerk von Novartis umfasst. Sie werden Patente veröffentlichen, präsentieren und einreichen. Und durch das Genesis-Programm werden Sie etwas erleben, was in der Forschung und Entwicklung großer Unternehmen wirklich selten ist: die Energie, das Tempo und die kreative Breite eines Startups, kombiniert mit den Ressourcen und der Pipeline eines Top-Fünf-Pharmaunternehmens.

Résumé de la description d'emploi
18. C'est le nombre de mois que vous passerez dans Global Discovery Chemistry (GDC) comme postdoc industriel, travaillant au cœur de l'initiative d'innovation interne la plus ambitieuse de Novartis, le programme Genesis. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un chercheur de troisième cycle hautement motivé et audacieux avec une expertise en biocatalyse, en génie des protéines, en biologie synthétique ou dans un domaine étroitement lié, prêt à développer des plateformes technologiques de transformation qui remodelent la façon dont les médicaments sont découverts et fabriqués.

Ce n'est pas un postdoc conventionnel. Genesis est le programme d'innovation interne phare de Novartis, structuré comme une start-up interne au sein de l'une des plus grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques du monde. Pensez-y comme le défi intellectuel et le rythme d'une biotechnologie en phase initiale, soutenue par les ressources, la profondeur scientifique et le pipeline de Novartis Biomedical Research. Nous vous encouragerons à aller vite, à penser grand et à travailler sur des problèmes qui comptent — avec le soutien d'une équipe interdisciplinaire de classe mondiale autour de vous.

Ce rôle est une occasion unique de travailler à la pointe de la biocatalyse appliquée et de l'ingénierie protéique, à l'interface entre la recherche et le développement, avec un impact direct sur le portefeuille de Novartis. Non seulement vous transférerez vos connaissances scientifiques dans la pratique, mais vous développerez vos compétences en leadership, créerez un puissant réseau interne et externe et jetterez les bases d'une carrière exceptionnelle dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou le milieu universitaire.

Description de l'emploi
Vos responsabilités
Vos responsabilités comprennent, entre autres :

• Concevoir et développer des plateformes technologiques innovantes en biocatalyse et en génie protéique dans le cadre du programme phare Genesis, en faisant progresser rapidement les capacités de découverte de Novartis.

• Mener des campagnes de découverte et d'ingénierie enzymatiques — en tirant parti des derniers outils informatiques et du dépistage automatisé à haut débit — pour identifier et optimiser les nouveaux biocatalyseurs pour les applications de synthèse pharmaceutique.

• Élaborer de nouvelles solutions synthétiques biocatalytiques qui permettent une préparation efficace, évolutive et durable des candidats aux médicaments selon de nouvelles modalités, de la découverte précoce à l'offre clinique et commerciale.

• Obtenez une exposition à la chimie peptidique et aux technologies d'affichage pour élargir la portée et la diversité des solutions biocatalytiques disponibles pour le portefeuille Novartis.

• Appliquer des plateformes d'automatisation de pointe et une automatisation avancée pour le dépistage des enzymes à haut débit, l'expérimentation riche en données et l' itération rapide dans toutes les campagnes d'ingénierie.

• Contribuer à la définition d'une stratégie scientifique sur les projets du programme Genesis — identifier les occasions audacieuses, concevoir de nouvelles approches expérimentales et aider à orienter la plateforme.

• Collaborer avec des experts de calibre mondial en biologie moléculaire, en biochimie, en bioinformatique, en chimie des procédés, en génie chimique et en chimie analytique à Novartis et avec des partenaires universitaires et industriels externes.

• Communiquez votre science — présentez vos résultats à l'interne, contribuez aux brevets et rendez la science complexe accessible à divers publics.

Ce que vous allez apporter au rôle

• PhD à l'interface de la chimie et de la biologie avec un accent sur la biocatalyse, la biologie synthétique, le génie enzymatique ou une discipline étroitement liée.

• L'expérience dans le développement de transformations enzymatiques modifiant les peptides ou les protéines est privilégiée.

• Forte expérience de la recherche originale et la capacité de développer des transformations (bio)catalytiques innovantes.

• La curiosité scientifique et l'esprit d'équipe pour travailler efficacement à l'interface de multiples disciplines scientifiques dans un environnement multiculturel et rapide.

• Des compétences interpersonnelles et de communication efficaces sont essentielles.

• Une connaissance efficace de l'anglais, tant oralement qu'écrit, est nécessaire.

• L'expérience des technologies de pointe en matière de débit, de calcul ou d'affichage ainsi que de l'expérience postdoctorale est un autre avantage, mais pas une exigence.

Pourquoi considérer Novartis?
750 millions. C'est combien de vies nos produits touchent. Et bien que nous en soyons fiers, dans ce monde de transformation numérique et technologique, nous devons aussi nous demander : comment pouvons-nous continuer à améliorer et à étendre encore plus la vie des gens ?

Nous croyons que les réponses sont trouvées lorsque des gens curieux, courageux et collaboratifs comme vous sont habilités à poser de nouvelles questions, à prendre des décisions plus audacieuses et à prendre des risques plus intelligents.

Chez Novartis Biomedical Research, vous aurez accès à une infrastructure de pointe : automatisation avancée, dépistage à haut débit, plateformes de calcul et capacités de biologie structurelle. Vous serez encadré par des scientifiques de calibre mondial et intégré dans une communauté scientifique qui s'étend aux dirigeants universitaires, aux partenaires de l'industrie et au réseau mondial Novartis. Vous publierez, présenterez et déposerez des brevets. Et grâce au programme Genesis, vous vivrez quelque chose de vraiment rare dans la R-D des grandes entreprises : l'énergie, le rythme et la latitude créative d'une start-up, combinée aux ressources et au pipeline d'une entreprise pharmaceutique mondiale des cinq premiers.

Job Description Summary
Location: Muttenz, Switzerland #LI-Hybrid 3 days/week in office

Internal job title: DDIT OPS Robotics Expert ITOT

The Site Robotics Expert will lead the robotics transformation of the manufacturing site in Muttenz, Switzerland, driving the development, implementation, scaling, and lifecycle management of robotics solutions across manufacturing, laboratories, warehousing, and material handling. The role bridges emerging robotics technologies with site needs — moving solutions from market scan to shop floor — by combining deep technical expertise with close proximity to the vendor and innovation ecosystem. As the site's robotics expert, the individual will collaborate with local and global stakeholders, engineering, operations, quality, IT/OT teams, and technology partners to build a sustainable robotics ecosystem.

Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

• Own the site robotics technology strategy and keep it continuously refreshed against market, vendor, and emerging-technology developments.

• Evaluate shared Work Centre standards and strategy, harmonising requirements across platforms and aligning global ways of working to ensure common requirements are defined, captured, and embedded consistently

• Own the User Requirement Specifications (URSs) and the technology & robotics roadmap for shared Work Centers, aligning common versus platform-specific requirements.

• Translate scouted technology into standardized, site-ready deployment packages — delivering implementable solutions, not just recommendations.

• Own and maintain the Robotics Catalogue for shared Work Centers, keeping availability, readiness, ownership, and technical details current

• Lead technology and market scouting, with dedicated focus on advanced capability areas such as computer vision, automated inspection, and physical AI, closing current resourcing gaps in these domains.

• Evaluate vendor capability and performance, and partner with Procurement on the selection and management of standard, approved vendors.

• Maintain continuous alignment with sites ensuring evaluated technologies are actually piloted and adopted — and that site feedback shapes the next roadmap cycle.

• Report progress on a regular cadence to the Robotics Steering Committee and support sites roadmap endorsement and monthly technical syncs.

• Ensure compliance with GMP regulations and security protocols.

• Coordinate with vendors and partners for support and procurement.

Essential Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 5+ years of demonstrated experience in robotics , with hands-on implementation and deployment of industrial robotics solutions.

• Experience leading robotics or automation projects from concept through implementation and operational support, with strong understanding of robotics hardware, integration, and automation architectures.

• Proven track record of evaluating, selecting, and deploying robotics or automation technologies from concept to shop floor

• Experience defining technical standards, User Requirement Specifications (URSs), and vendor evaluation criteria

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills , with experience engaging both global and local business partners.

• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written).

• Strong understanding of industrial operations, safety, maintenance, and continuous improvement practices;

• Exposure to AI-enabled robotics.

• Knowledge of GMP requirements, data integrity (ALCOA+), and validation principles in regulated manufacturing

Desirable Requirements :

• Expertise in robotics technologies such as AMRs, AGVs, automated material handling systems, robotics automation, and vision-guided systems

• Exposure to GMP/pharmaceutical environments is preferred.

• German fluency would be preferred.

Benefits & Rewards

Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role: : CHF 88,200 to CHF 163,800.

In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters.
The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave.
Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering:
https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf
Note: Benefits and compensation may vary by country and are subject to local legal requirements, including provisions of collective bargaining agreements where applicable. A full overview of your compensation package, including any relevant collective bargaining agreement details applicable to your role based on your employment location and Novartis employer entity, will be communicated separately to you during the application process.

Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

Why Novartis?
Our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people’s lives and our vision is to become the most valued and trusted medicines company in the world. How can we achieve this? With our people. It is our associates that drive us each day to reach our ambitions. Be a part of this mission and join us! Business Continuity, Cost Management, Decision Making, Operational Excellence, Problem Solving, Project Management, Quality Compliance, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Vendor Management
